Ich werde jetzt einen umfassenden deutschsprachigen Leitfaden schreiben, der die Missverständnisse rund um "Supercomputer" klärt und praktische Schritte mit Code-Beispielen für Hardware, Speicher, Voice-Integration, Always-On-Kanäle, Tools und Automation sowie Business-Skalierung abdeckt.Kurz vorweg, damit du nicht falsch investierst: Der "Supercomputer" ist bei diesem Ansatz nicht dein Rechner. Das eigentliche Sprachmodell läuft in Anthropics Rechenzentrum – dein Gerät muss nur ständig laufen, orchestrieren und deine Daten halten. Das ändert, was du wirklich brauchst, im Guten: viel günstiger, dafür anders aufgebaut. Hier ist der komplette Bauplan.

## Schritt 1 – Basis: ein Server, der nie schläft

Jarvis braucht einen Ort, der 24/7 läuft, weil Sessions, Automatisierungen und Channels nur aktiv sind, während ein Prozess offen ist.

- **Hardware**: reicht ein Mini-PC (Intel NUC, Mac mini), ein altes Notebook oder ein günstiger VPS (Hetzner, DigitalOcean). Keine GPU nötig – die bräuchtest du nur, wenn du zusätzlich ein *lokales* Modell laufen lassen willst (z.B. für Offline-Spracherkennung).
- **Software**: Node.js + `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`, dann `claude` starten und mit deinem Claude-Account oder API-Key einloggen.
- **Abo**: Für Dauerbetrieb mit vielen Agenten lohnt sich ein Max-Abo oder ein Console-API-Key mit Spend-Limit, damit du die Kosten im Griff hast.

## Schritt 2 – Gedächtnis & Daten

Das ist das Herzstück von "kennt meine ganzen Daten":

- **`CLAUDE.md`** im Hauptverzeichnis: feste Fakten über dich, deine Vorlieben, laufende Projekte, Business-Kontext. Wird bei jeder Session automatisch geladen.
- **Auto Memory**: Claude Code merkt sich Dinge zwischen Sessions selbstständig – du kannst das mit `/memory` einsehen und korrigieren.
- **MCP-Server als Datenquellen**: Google Drive, Notion, lokale Dateisysteme, Datenbanken (Postgres etc.) anbinden, damit Jarvis wirklich auf deine echten Daten zugreift statt zu raten.
- Für sehr große Dokumentenmengen (PDFs, Notizen, Forschung): eine kleine Vektor-Datenbank (z.B. Chroma oder Postgres+pgvector) als eigener MCP-Server, damit Jarvis gezielt durchsuchen statt alles neu lesen muss.

Beispiel für den Anfang einer `CLAUDE.md`:
```markdown
# Über mich
- Ziel: persönlicher Assistent + später Aufbau mehrerer Businesses
- Sprache: Deutsch, direkte und knappe Antworten bevorzugt

# Regeln
- Nie autonom Geld ausgeben oder Verträge abschließen ohne Rückfrage
- Bei Unsicherheit: nachfragen statt raten
```

## Schritt 3 – Sprache: wirklich mit ihm reden

- **Sofort nutzbar**: `/voice` in der CLI – gesprochene Eingabe wird live transkribiert (Hold-to-record oder Tap-to-record), auch über Sprachen wie Deutsch hinweg.
- **Echtes Zwei-Wege-Gespräch** (sprechen *und* Antwort hören): dafür baust du mit dem **Agent SDK** (Python oder TypeScript) einen eigenen dünnen Wrapper: Mikrofon → Speech-to-Text (z.B. Whisper) → Prompt an Claude Agent SDK → Antworttext → Text-to-Speech (ElevenLabs oder lokal Piper) → Lautsprecher. Das ist der Baustein, der aus "Chat-Tool" wirklich "Jarvis" macht.
- **Unterwegs**: Claude Mobile App mit Remote Control – du steuerst deine laufende Server-Session vom Handy aus, inklusive Push-Benachrichtigungen, wenn Jarvis auf dich wartet.

## Schritt 4 – Immer erreichbar

Damit du ihn jederzeit ansprechen kannst, nicht nur wenn du am Terminal sitzt:

- **Channels**: Telegram-, Discord- oder (auf macOS) iMessage-Bot als Chat-Brücke zu deiner laufenden Session einrichten (`/plugin install telegram@claude-plugins-official`, Token konfigurieren, mit `--channels` starten). Du schreibst ihm von überall, er antwortet im selben Chat und arbeitet dabei auf deinem echten Rechner mit deinen echten Dateien.
- **Scheduled Tasks / Routinen**: wiederkehrende Aufgaben automatisch anstoßen lassen – z.B. jeden Morgen eine Datenanalyse, jeden Abend ein Business-Report per Telegram.

## Schritt 5 – Tools & Agenten

- **MCP-Server** für alles, was Jarvis anfassen soll: Smart Home (Home Assistant hat einen offiziellen MCP-Server – Lichter, Automationen, Sensor-Daten), E-Mail/Kalender, GitHub, Business-Software.
- **Subagents**: spezialisierte Mini-Agenten mit eigenem Kontext und eigenen Tool-Rechten – z.B. ein "Rechercheur", ein "Data Scientist", ein "Debugger". Claude delegiert automatisch oder du rufst sie explizit auf.
- **Agent Teams**: mehrere Subagents parallel an einem größeren Vorhaben arbeiten lassen (z.B. Konkurrenzanalyse aus drei Blickwinkeln gleichzeitig).

Beispiel für einen eigenen Subagenten (`.claude/agents/business-analyst.md`):
```markdown
---
name: business-analyst
description: Analysiert Markt- und Finanzdaten für neue Business-Ideen
tools: WebSearch, WebFetch, Read
---
Du analysierst Daten nüchtern und datenbasiert. Liefere immer:
Chancen, Risiken, nötige nächste Schritte.
```

## Schritt 6 – Autonomie, aber mit Leitplanken

Bevor er "eigenständig ausführen" darf, brauchst du Sicherheitsnetze:

- **Permission Modes**: `plan` zum Prüfen bevor etwas passiert, `acceptEdits` für Routinearbeiten, `bypassPermissions` nur in einer isolierten Sandbox/Container.
- **Sandboxing**: riskante Aktionen in einem Container oder einer VM laufen lassen, nicht direkt auf deinem Hauptsystem.
- **Hooks**: feste Regeln, die *nie* umgangen werden – z.B. "vor jeder Zahlung stoppen und fragen", "vor riskanten Löschaktionen ein Backup anlegen".

## Schritt 7 – Business-Erweiterung

Wenn die Basis steht, skalierst du einfach horizontal:

- Für jedes Business ein eigener Ordner/Workspace mit eigener `CLAUDE.md` (Zielgruppe, Zahlen, Strategie) und eigenen Subagents.
- Das **Agent SDK** nutzen, um daraus eigene, eigenständige Anwendungen zu bauen (z.B. ein automatisierter Kundenservice-Bot, ein Reporting-Tool) – nicht mehr nur ein Chat-Fenster, sondern ein Produkt.
- Routinen/GitHub Actions für automatisiertes Monitoring, Reports und wiederkehrende Aufgaben je Business.

Google Drive oder Home Assistant) anbinden. Alles andere baust du danach Stück für Stück drauf.

Alles klar, das ist ein bekanntes, harmloses Problem – kein echtes 32-Bit-System, sondern die falsche PowerShell-Variante. Windows hat zwei PowerShell-Einträge im Startmenü: **"Windows PowerShell"** und **"Windows PowerShell (x86)"**. Die x86-Variante läuft als 32-Bit-Prozess und löst genau diesen Fehler aus, auch auf einem ganz normalen 64-Bit-PC.

So behebst du es:

**1. Kurz prüfen, dass dein Windows wirklich 64-Bit ist**
Im selben (fehlerhaften) Fenster eingeben:
```powershell
[Environment]::Is64BitOperatingSystem
```
Kommt `True` zurück, ist dein System in Ordnung – dann liegt's an der PowerShell-Variante. Kommt `False`, hast du tatsächlich eine 32-Bit-Windows-Version, die Claude Code nicht unterstützt (bei aktuellen PCs sehr unwahrscheinlich).

**2. Fenster schließen, richtige PowerShell öffnen**
Windows-Taste → "PowerShell" eintippen → achte darauf, dass **kein** "(x86)" hinter dem Eintrag steht → öffnen.

**3. Installationsbefehl erneut ausführen**
```powershell
irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```

Danach wie vorher: Fenster neu starten, dann `claude --version` prüfen. Meld dich, wenn das durchläuft.

Die zwei häufigsten Ursachen sind:

1. **"claude wird nicht als Befehl erkannt"** → dann ist der Installationsordner noch nicht im PATH.
2. **Ein anderer Fehlertext** → dann könnte es ein anderes Problem sein (z.B. Antivirus, Firewall, Zertifikat).

Für Fall 1 kannst du direkt das hier probieren:
```powershell
setx PATH "$env:PATH;$env:USERPROFILE\.local\bin"
```
Danach PowerShell **nochmal komplett schließen und neu öffnen** (wichtig, `setx` wirkt erst im nächsten Fenster) und erneut:

```powershell
claude --version
```

```powershell
# Rolle
Du arbeitest auf dem Niveau eines Senior Product Designer mit Front-End-Kompetenz – durchdachtes, eigenständiges Design statt generischer Templates.

# Methodik
1. Zweck und Zielgruppe der Seite/des Interfaces zuerst klären, bevor du gestaltest
2. Bewusste, konsistente Design-Entscheidungen treffen (Typografie, Farben, Abstände) statt Standard-Defaults zu übernehmen
3. Mobile- und Desktop-Darstellung mitdenken, nicht nur eine Bildschirmgröße
4. Zugänglichkeit (Kontraste, Lesbarkeit, klare Struktur) von Anfang an einplanen, nicht nachträglich

# Qualitätsstandards
- Kein generisches "KI-Standard-Design" (immer gleiche Layouts, immer gleiche Schriften/Farben)
- Klare visuelle Hierarchie: das Wichtigste fällt sofort auf
- Sauberer, wartbarer Code – kein aufgeblähtes Markup nur für den Effekt
- Konsistenz: gleiche Elemente (Buttons, Abstände, Farben) im ganzen Projekt einheitlich

Kurze Erklärung der Design-Entscheidung (2-3 Sätze), danach der fertige Code/das Ergebnis.
```

```powershell

$status = git status --porcelain

    git push
}
```

```powershell
$englishWords = @("the","and","is","not","with","for","you","we","they","on","or","how","what","are")

$germanCount = 0
$englishCount = 0
foreach ($w in $germanWords) { $germanCount += ([regex]::Matches($text, "\b$w\b", "IgnoreCase")).Count }
foreach ($w in $englishWords) { $englishCount += ([regex]::Matches($text, "\b$w\b", "IgnoreCase")).Count }

if ($englishCount -gt $germanCount) {

} else {

$player.Play()
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
$timeout = 0

  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
  $timeout++
}
if ($player.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan) {

}
$player.Close()
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\.claude\hooks\speak-response.ps1 -Encoding UTF8
```

**2. Die Orb-Oberfläche selbst**
```powershell
@'
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Jarvis</title>
<style>
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@400;700&display=swap");
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #0a0a12 0%, #000 100%);
  height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif;
}
.orb {
  width: 180px;
  height: 180px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #7fd8ff, #1a5f8a 60%, #062033 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 40px 10px rgba(80, 200, 255, 0.5), 0 0 90px 30px rgba(80, 200, 255, 0.25);
  transition: all 0.8s ease;
  animation: pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.ring {
  position: absolute;
  width: 260px;
  height: 260px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(120, 210, 255, 0.3);
  animation: spin 12s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
  50% { transform: scale(1.06); }
}
@keyframes spin {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}
.thinking { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #ffd27f, #8a5a1a, #331a06); box-shadow: 0 0 40px 10px rgba(255, 180, 80, 0.5), 0 0 90px 30px rgba(255, 180, 80, 0.25); animation: pulse 0.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
.speaking { animation: pulse 0.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
#label { position: absolute; bottom: 60px; color: #7fd8ff; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 3px; opacity: 0.6; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="ring"></div>
<div class="orb" id="orb"></div>
<div id="label">STANDBY</div>
<script>
async function poll() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("status.json?t=" + Date.now());
    const data = await res.json();
    const orb = document.getElementById("orb");
    const label = document.getElementById("label");
    orb.className = "orb";
    if (data.status === "thinking") { orb.classList.add("thinking"); label.textContent = "DENKT NACH"; }
    else if (data.status === "speaking") { orb.classList.add("speaking"); label.textContent = "ANTWORTET"; }
    else { label.textContent = "BEREIT"; }
  } catch (e) {}
  setTimeout(poll, 400);
}
poll();
</script>
</body>
</html>
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\orb\index.html -Encoding UTF8
```

**2. Sprachausgabe-Skript erweitern, damit es den Status setzt**
```powershell
@'
$statusPath = "C:\Jarvis\orb\status.json"

$inputJson = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
$data = $inputJson | ConvertFrom-Json
$transcriptPath = $data.transcript_path
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($transcriptPath) -or -not (Test-Path $transcriptPath)) {
    Set-Content -Path $statusPath -Value (@{status="idle"} | ConvertTo-Json) -Encoding UTF8
    exit
}

$lastAssistantText = $null
Get-Content $transcriptPath | ForEach-Object {
    try { $entry = $_ | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { return }
    if ($entry.type -eq "assistant" -and $entry.message.content) {
        $textBlocks = $entry.message.content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq "text" } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }
        if ($textBlocks) { $lastAssistantText = ($textBlocks -join "`n") }
    }
}

$text = $lastAssistantText
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($text)) {
    Set-Content -Path $statusPath -Value (@{status="idle"} | ConvertTo-Json) -Encoding UTF8
    exit
}

$text = $text -replace "[*_#``]", ""
$text = $text -replace "\[(.+?)\]\(.+?\)", "`$1"

Set-Content -Path $statusPath -Value (@{status="speaking"} | ConvertTo-Json) -Encoding UTF8

$txtPath = "$env:TEMP\jarvis-response.txt"
$mp3Path = "$env:TEMP\jarvis-response.mp3"
Set-Content -Path $txtPath -Value $text -Encoding UTF8

edge-tts --voice "en-GB-RyanNeural" --rate="-8%" --pitch="-5Hz" --file $txtPath --write-media $mp3Path

Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationCore
$player = New-Object System.Windows.Media.MediaPlayer
$player.Open([Uri]$mp3Path)
$player.Play()
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
$timeout = 0
while (-not $player.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan -and $timeout -lt 50) {
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
  $timeout++
}
if ($player.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan) {
  Start-Sleep -Seconds $player.NaturalDuration.TimeSpan.TotalSeconds
}
$player.Close()

Set-Content -Path $statusPath -Value (@{status="idle"} | ConvertTo-Json) -Encoding UTF8
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\.claude\hooks\speak-response.ps1 -Encoding UTF8
```

```powershell
@'
$statusPath = "C:\Jarvis\orb\status.json"
$tasksPath = "C:\Jarvis\TASKS.md"

function Get-OpenTasks {
    if (Test-Path $tasksPath) {
        $lines = Get-Content $tasksPath | Where-Object { $_ -match "^\s*-\s*\[ \]" }
        return @($lines | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace "^\s*-\s*\[ \]\s*", "" })
    }
    return @()
}

$inputJson = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
$data = $inputJson | ConvertFrom-Json
$transcriptPath = $data.transcript_path

$tasks = Get-OpenTasks

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($transcriptPath) -or -not (Test-Path $transcriptPath)) {
    @{status="idle"; lastMessage=""; tasks=$tasks} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path $statusPath -Encoding UTF8
    exit
}

$lastAssistantText = $null
Get-Content $transcriptPath | ForEach-Object {
    try { $entry = $_ | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { return }
    if ($entry.type -eq "assistant" -and $entry.message.content) {
        $textBlocks = $entry.message.content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq "text" } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }
        if ($textBlocks) { $lastAssistantText = ($textBlocks -join "`n") }
    }
}

$text = $lastAssistantText
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($text)) {
    @{status="idle"; lastMessage=""; tasks=$tasks} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path $statusPath -Encoding UTF8
    exit
}

$text = $text -replace "[*_#``]", ""
$text = $text -replace "\[(.+?)\]\(.+?\)", "`$1"

@{status="speaking"; lastMessage=$text; tasks=$tasks} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path $statusPath -Encoding UTF8

$txtPath = "$env:TEMP\jarvis-response.txt"
$mp3Path = "$env:TEMP\jarvis-response.mp3"
Set-Content -Path $txtPath -Value $text -Encoding UTF8

edge-tts --voice "en-GB-RyanNeural" --rate="-8%" --pitch="-5Hz" --file $txtPath --write-media $mp3Path

Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationCore
$player = New-Object System.Windows.Media.MediaPlayer
$player.Open([Uri]$mp3Path)
$player.Play()
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
$timeout = 0
while (-not $player.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan -and $timeout -lt 50) {
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
  $timeout++
}
if ($player.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan) {
  Start-Sleep -Seconds $player.NaturalDuration.TimeSpan.TotalSeconds
}
$player.Close()

@{status="idle"; lastMessage=$text; tasks=$tasks} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path $statusPath -Encoding UTF8
```

```powershell
async function poll() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("status.json?t=" + Date.now());
    const data = await res.json();
    const orb = document.getElementById("orb");
    const label = document.getElementById("label");
    orb.className = "orb";
    if (data.status === "thinking") { orb.classList.add("thinking"); label.textContent = "THINKING"; }
    else if (data.status === "speaking") { orb.classList.add("speaking"); label.textContent = "RESPONDING"; }
    else { label.textContent = "READY"; }

    document.getElementById("chatlog").textContent = data.lastMessage || "—";

    const list = document.getElementById("tasklist");
    list.innerHTML = "";
    if (data.tasks && data.tasks.length > 0) {
      data.tasks.forEach(t => {
        const li = document.createElement("li");
        li.textContent = t;
        list.appendChild(li);
      });
    } else {
      list.innerHTML = "<li>none</li>";
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  setTimeout(poll, 400);
}
poll();
</script>
</body>
```

.ring-inner { animation: spin 20s linear infinite; transform-origin: 220px 220px; }

#orb { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 150px; height: 150px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #baffef, #0f6e5f 55%, #041e19 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 40px 10px rgba(90,255,230,0.5), 0 0 100px 34px rgba(90,255,230,0.22); animation: pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite; z-index: 2; }

.thinking { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #ffe0a3, #6e4a0f 55%, #1e1504 100%) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 40px 10px rgba(255,190,90,0.5), 0 0 100px 34px rgba(255,190,90,0.22) !important; animation: pulse 0.8s ease-in-out infinite !important; }
.speaking { animation: pulse 0.4s ease-in-out infinite !important; }

@keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.06); } }
@keyframes spin { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

<body>
<div class="scanlines"></div>
<div class="tickbar top"></div>
<div class="tickbar bottom"></div>
<div class="corner tl"></div>
<div class="corner tr"></div>
<div class="corner bl"></div>
<div class="corner br"></div>

<div class="panel" id="clockPanel">
  <h3>SYSTEM TIME</h3>
  <div id="clock">00:00:00</div>
  <div id="dateline">—</div>
  <div id="telemetry">
    CPU <span id="tCpu">--</span>%<br>
    LINK <span id="tLink">--</span> ms<br>
    PWR <span id="tPwr">--</span>%
  </div>
</div>

<div class="panel" id="taskPanel">
  <h3>OPEN TASKS</h3>
  <div class="bars" id="bars"></div>
  <ul id="tasklist"><li>none</li></ul>
</div>

<div class="stage">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 440 440">
    <defs>
      <filter id="glow"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.2" result="blur"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter>
    </defs>
    <g class="ring-outer" filter="url(#glow)" fill="none" stroke="#5affe6" stroke-width="1.5">
      <circle cx="220" cy="220" r="210" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-dasharray="2 6"/>
      <g id="tickOuter"></g>
    </g>
    <g class="ring-mid" filter="url(#glow)" fill="none" stroke="#5affe6" stroke-width="2">
      <circle cx="220" cy="220" r="165" stroke-opacity="0.35" stroke-dasharray="14 4 4 4"/>
    </g>
    <g class="ring-inner" filter="url(#glow)" fill="none" stroke="#5affe6" stroke-width="1">
      <circle cx="220" cy="220" r="125" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-dasharray="1 5"/>
    </g>
    <g class="sweep-group">
      <line x1="220" y1="220" x2="220" y2="20" stroke="#baffef" stroke-width="2" stroke-opacity="0.8" filter="url(#glow)"/>
      <path d="M 220 220 L 220 20 A 200 200 0 0 1 260 25 Z" fill="#5affe6" opacity="0.08"/>
    </g>
  </svg>
  <div id="orb"></div>
  <div id="label">STANDBY</div>
</div>

<div class="panel" id="logPanel">
  <h3>LAST RESPONSE</h3>
  <div id="chatlog">—</div>
</div>

<div class="panel" id="statusPanel">
  <h3>VOICE STATUS</h3>
  <div id="statusOrbMini"></div>
  <div id="statusLabel">READY</div>
</div>

<script>
const tickOuter = document.getElementById("tickOuter");
for (let i = 0; i < 72; i++) {
  const angle = (i / 72) * 360;
  const len = i % 6 === 0 ? 14 : 6;
  const rad = angle * Math.PI / 180;
  const r1 = 210, r2 = 210 - len;
  const x1 = 220 + r1 * Math.cos(rad), y1 = 220 + r1 * Math.sin(rad);
  const x2 = 220 + r2 * Math.cos(rad), y2 = 220 + r2 * Math.sin(rad);
  const line = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "line");
  line.setAttribute("x1", x1); line.setAttribute("y1", y1);
  line.setAttribute("x2", x2); line.setAttribute("y2", y2);
  line.setAttribute("stroke-opacity", i % 6 === 0 ? "0.8" : "0.35");
  tickOuter.appendChild(line);
}

function updateClock() {
  const now = new Date();
  document.getElementById("clock").textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString();
  document.getElementById("dateline").textContent = now.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: "short", year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}
updateClock();
setInterval(updateClock, 1000);

function tickTelemetry() {
  document.getElementById("tCpu").textContent = (12 + Math.random() * 12).toFixed(0);
  document.getElementById("tLink").textContent = (18 + Math.random() * 9).toFixed(0);
  document.getElementById("tPwr").textContent = (88 + Math.random() * 8).toFixed(0);
}
tickTelemetry();
setInterval(tickTelemetry, 1400);

function renderBars(n) {
  const bars = document.getElementById("bars");
  bars.innerHTML = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const bar = document.createElement("div");
    bar.className = "bar";
    bar.style.height = (20 + Math.random() * 20) + "px";
    bar.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.15) + "s";
    bars.appendChild(bar);
  }
}

let lastRenderedMessage = "";
function typewrite(text) {
  if (text === lastRenderedMessage) return;
  lastRenderedMessage = text;
  const el = document.getElementById("chatlog");
  el.textContent = "";
  let i = 0;
  const speed = 12;
  function step() {
    if (i <= text.length) {
      el.textContent = text.slice(0, i);
      i += 3;
      setTimeout(step, speed);
    }
  }
  step();
}

async function poll() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("status.json?t=" + Date.now());
    const data = await res.json();
    const orb = document.getElementById("orb");
    const statusOrb = document.getElementById("statusOrbMini");
    const label = document.getElementById("label");
    const statusLabel = document.getElementById("statusLabel");

    orb.className = ""; orb.id = "orb";
    statusOrb.className = ""; statusOrb.id = "statusOrbMini";

    if (data.status === "thinking") {
      orb.classList.add("thinking"); statusOrb.classList.add("thinking");
      label.textContent = "THINKING"; statusLabel.textContent = "THINKING";
    } else if (data.status === "speaking") {
      orb.classList.add("speaking"); statusOrb.classList.add("speaking");
      label.textContent = "RESPONDING"; statusLabel.textContent = "SPEAKING";
    } else {
      label.textContent = "READY"; statusLabel.textContent = "READY";
    }

    typewrite(data.lastMessage || "—");

    const list = document.getElementById("tasklist");
    list.innerHTML = "";
    const tasks = data.tasks || [];
    if (tasks.length > 0) {
      tasks.forEach(t => { const li = document.createElement("li"); li.textContent = t; list.appendChild(li); });
    } else {
      list.innerHTML = "<li>none</li>";
    }
    renderBars(tasks.length);
  } catch (e) {}
  setTimeout(poll, 400);
}
renderBars(0);
poll();
</script>
</body>
</html>

```powershell
<script>
const tickOuter = document.getElementById("tickOuter");
for (let i = 0; i < 72; i++) {
  const angle = (i / 72) * 360, len = i % 6 === 0 ? 12 : 5, rad = angle * Math.PI / 180;
  const r1 = 180, r2 = 180 - len;
  const x1 = 190 + r1 * Math.cos(rad), y1 = 190 + r1 * Math.sin(rad);
  const x2 = 190 + r2 * Math.cos(rad), y2 = 190 + r2 * Math.sin(rad);
  const line = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "line");
  line.setAttribute("x1", x1); line.setAttribute("y1", y1); line.setAttribute("x2", x2); line.setAttribute("y2", y2);
  line.setAttribute("stroke-opacity", i % 6 === 0 ? "0.8" : "0.35");
  tickOuter.appendChild(line);
}
function updateClock() {
  const now = new Date();
  document.getElementById("clock").textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString();
  document.getElementById("dateline").textContent = now.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: "short", year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}
updateClock(); setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
function tickTelemetry() {
  document.getElementById("tCpu").textContent = (12 + Math.random() * 12).toFixed(0);
  document.getElementById("tLink").textContent = (18 + Math.random() * 9).toFixed(0);
  document.getElementById("tPwr").textContent = (88 + Math.random() * 8).toFixed(0);
}
tickTelemetry(); setInterval(tickTelemetry, 1400);
const hexChars = "0123456789ABCDEF";
function randHex(len) { let s = ""; for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) s += hexChars[Math.floor(Math.random() * 16)]; return s; }
function tickDataStream() {
  const lines = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) lines.push("0x" + randHex(8) + "  " + randHex(2) + " " + randHex(2));
  document.getElementById("datastream").textContent = lines.join("\n");
}
tickDataStream(); setInterval(tickDataStream, 900);
function renderBars(n) {
  const bars = document.getElementById("bars"); bars.innerHTML = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const bar = document.createElement("div"); bar.className = "bar";
    bar.style.height = (16 + Math.random() * 18) + "px"; bar.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.15) + "s";
    bars.appendChild(bar);
  }
}
let lastRenderedMessage = "";
function typewrite(text) {
  if (text === lastRenderedMessage) return;
  lastRenderedMessage = text;
  const el = document.getElementById("chatlog"); el.textContent = "";
  let i = 0;
  function step() { if (i <= text.length) { el.textContent = text.slice(0, i); i += 3; setTimeout(step, 12); } }
  step();
}
const lineData = Array.from({length: 24}, () => 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4);
const lc = document.getElementById("lineChart").getContext("2d");
function drawLineChart() {
  lineData.shift(); lineData.push(Math.max(0.1, Math.min(0.9, lineData[lineData.length-1] + (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25)));
  lc.clearRect(0,0,170,44);
  lc.strokeStyle = "#5affe6"; lc.lineWidth = 1.2; lc.beginPath();
  lineData.forEach((v,i) => { const x = i*(170/23), y = 44 - v*40; i===0?lc.moveTo(x,y):lc.lineTo(x,y); });
  lc.stroke();
}
let wavePhase = 0;
const wc = document.getElementById("waveChart").getContext("2d");
function drawWave() {
  wavePhase += 0.25;
  wc.clearRect(0,0,170,28);
  wc.strokeStyle = "#5affe6"; wc.lineWidth = 1; wc.beginPath();
  for (let x = 0; x < 170; x++) {
    const y = 14 + Math.sin(x*0.15 + wavePhase) * 8 * Math.sin(x*0.02);
    x===0?wc.moveTo(x,y):wc.lineTo(x,y);
  }
  wc.stroke();
  requestAnimationFrame(drawWave);
}
setInterval(drawLineChart, 700);
drawWave();
const rc = document.getElementById("radarChart").getContext("2d");
let radarValues = [0.6,0.7,0.5,0.8,0.6];
function drawRadar() {
  rc.clearRect(0,0,150,150);
  const cx=75, cy=75, R=55, sides=5;
  rc.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,255,230,0.3)"; rc.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let ring=1; ring<=3; ring++) {
    rc.beginPath();
    for (let i=0;i<=sides;i++) {
      const a = -Math.PI/2 + i*(2*Math.PI/sides), r = R*ring/3;
      const x = cx + r*Math.cos(a), y = cy + r*Math.sin(a);
      i===0?rc.moveTo(x,y):rc.lineTo(x,y);
    }
    rc.stroke();
  }
  for (let i=0;i<sides;i++) {
    const a = -Math.PI/2 + i*(2*Math.PI/sides);
    rc.beginPath(); rc.moveTo(cx,cy); rc.lineTo(cx+R*Math.cos(a), cy+R*Math.sin(a)); rc.stroke();
  }
  rc.beginPath(); rc.fillStyle = "rgba(90,255,230,0.2)"; rc.strokeStyle = "#5affe6"; rc.lineWidth = 1.5;
  radarValues.forEach((v,i) => {
    const a = -Math.PI/2 + i*(2*Math.PI/sides), r = R*v;
    const x = cx+r*Math.cos(a), y = cy+r*Math.sin(a);
    i===0?rc.moveTo(x,y):rc.lineTo(x,y);
  });
  rc.closePath(); rc.fill(); rc.stroke();
}
setInterval(() => { radarValues = radarValues.map(v => Math.max(0.3, Math.min(0.95, v + (Math.random()-0.5)*0.15))); drawRadar(); }, 1200);
drawRadar();
let globeScene, globeCamera, globeRenderer, globeMesh;
function initGlobe() {
  const container = document.getElementById("globeContainer");
  globeScene = new THREE.Scene();
  globeCamera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 0.1, 100);
  globeCamera.position.z = 3.2;
  globeRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ alpha: true, antialias: true });
  globeRenderer.setSize(150, 150);
  container.appendChild(globeRenderer.domElement);
  const geo = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1.3, 2);
  const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x5affe6, wireframe: true, transparent: true, opacity: 0.75 });
  globeMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  globeScene.add(globeMesh);
  const geo2 = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.05, 16, 16);
  const mat2 = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x5affe6, wireframe: true, transparent: true, opacity: 0.3 });
  globeScene.add(new THREE.Mesh(geo2, mat2));
  animateGlobe();
}
function animateGlobe() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animateGlobe);
  globeMesh.rotation.y += 0.006;
  globeMesh.rotation.x += 0.002;
  globeRenderer.render(globeScene, globeCamera);
}
if (window.THREE) initGlobe();
const stage = document.getElementById("stage");
document.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  const dx = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5) * 10;
  const dy = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 10;
  stage.style.transform = `translate(calc(-50% + ${dx}px), calc(-50% + ${dy}px))`;
});
async function poll() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("status.json?t=" + Date.now());
    const data = await res.json();
    const orb = document.getElementById("orb");
    const statusOrb = document.getElementById("statusOrbMini");
    const label = document.getElementById("label");
    const statusLabel = document.getElementById("statusLabel");
    orb.className = ""; orb.id = "orb"; statusOrb.className = ""; statusOrb.id = "statusOrbMini";
    if (data.status === "thinking") { orb.classList.add("thinking"); statusOrb.classList.add("thinking"); label.textContent = "THINKING"; statusLabel.textContent = "THINKING"; }
    else if (data.status === "speaking") { orb.classList.add("speaking"); statusOrb.classList.add("speaking"); label.textContent = "RESPONDING"; statusLabel.textContent = "SPEAKING"; }
    else { label.textContent = "READY"; statusLabel.textContent = "READY"; }
    typewrite(data.lastMessage || "—");
    const list = document.getElementById("tasklist"); list.innerHTML = "";
    const tasks = data.tasks || [];
    if (tasks.length > 0) tasks.forEach(t => { const li = document.createElement("li"); li.textContent = t; list.appendChild(li); });
    else list.innerHTML = "<li>none</li>";
    renderBars(tasks.length);
  } catch (e) {}
  setTimeout(poll, 400);
}
renderBars(0); poll();
</script>
```

```powershell
$newBlock = @'
let globeScene, globeCamera, globeRenderer, particles;
function initGlobe() {
  const container = document.getElementById("globeContainer");
  globeScene = new THREE.Scene();
  globeCamera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 0.1, 100);
  globeCamera.position.z = 3.2;
  globeRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ alpha: true, antialias: true });
  globeRenderer.setSize(150, 150);
  container.appendChild(globeRenderer.domElement);
  const count = 3000;
  const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
  const radius = 1.15;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const y = 1 - (i / (count - 1)) * 2;
    const r = Math.sqrt(1 - y * y);
    const theta = Math.PI * (1 + Math.sqrt(5)) * i;
    const x = Math.cos(theta) * r;
    const z = Math.sin(theta) * r;
    const jitter = 1 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06;
    positions[i*3] = x * radius * jitter;
    positions[i*3+1] = y * radius * jitter;
    positions[i*3+2] = z * radius * jitter;
  }
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = 16; canvas.height = 16;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(8,8,0,8,8,8);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,16,16);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ size: 0.045, map: tex, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85, color: 0xbaffef, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending });
  particles = new THREE.Points(geo, mat);
  globeScene.add(particles);
  animateGlobe();
}
function animateGlobe() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animateGlobe);
  particles.rotation.y += 0.004;
  particles.rotation.x = Math.sin(Date.now()*0.0002)*0.1;
  globeRenderer.render(globeScene, globeCamera);
}
if (window.THREE) initGlobe();
```

```powershell
  rc.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,255,230,0.3)"; rc.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let ring=1; ring<=3; ring++) {
    rc.beginPath();
    for (let i=0;i<=sides;i++) {
      const a = -Math.PI/2 + i*(2*Math.PI/sides), r = R*ring/3;
      const x = cx + r*Math.cos(a), y = cy + r*Math.sin(a);
      i===0?rc.moveTo(x,y):rc.lineTo(x,y);
    }
    rc.stroke();
  }
  for (let i=0;i<sides;i++) {
    const a = -Math.PI/2 + i*(2*Math.PI/sides);
    rc.beginPath(); rc.moveTo(cx,cy); rc.lineTo(cx+R*Math.cos(a), cy+R*Math.sin(a)); rc.stroke();
  }
  rc.beginPath(); rc.fillStyle = "rgba(90,255,230,0.2)"; rc.strokeStyle = "#5affe6"; rc.lineWidth = 1.5;
  radarValues.forEach((v,i) => {
    const a = -Math.PI/2 + i*(2*Math.PI/sides), r = R*v;
    const x = cx+r*Math.cos(a), y = cy+r*Math.sin(a);
    i===0?rc.moveTo(x,y):rc.lineTo(x,y);
  });
  rc.closePath(); rc.fill(); rc.stroke();
}
```

**1. Update the speech hook** (now writes audio for the browser to play, instead of playing it itself):

```powershell
@'
$inputJson = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
$data = $inputJson | ConvertFrom-Json
$transcriptPath = $data.transcript_path
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($transcriptPath) -or -not (Test-Path $transcriptPath)) { exit }

$lastAssistantText = $null
Get-Content $transcriptPath | ForEach-Object {
    try { $entry = $_ | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { return }
    if ($entry.type -eq "assistant" -and $entry.message.content) {
        $textBlocks = $entry.message.content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq "text" } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }
        if ($textBlocks) { $lastAssistantText = ($textBlocks -join "`n") }
    }
}

$text = $lastAssistantText
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($text)) { exit }

$text = $text -replace "[*_#``]", ""
$text = $text -replace "\[(.+?)\]\(.+?\)", "`$1"

$tasksPath = "C:\Jarvis\TASKS.md"
function Get-OpenTasks {
    if (Test-Path $tasksPath) {
        $lines = Get-Content $tasksPath | Where-Object { $_ -match "^\s*-\s*\[ \]" }
        return @($lines | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace "^\s*-\s*\[ \]\s*", "" })
    }
    return @()
}
$tasks = Get-OpenTasks

$txtPath = "$env:TEMP\jarvis-response.txt"
$mp3Path = "C:\Jarvis\orb\latest.mp3"
Set-Content -Path $txtPath -Value $text -Encoding UTF8

edge-tts --voice "en-GB-RyanNeural" --rate="-8%" --pitch="-5Hz" --file $txtPath --write-media $mp3Path

$audioToken = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
@{status="speaking"; lastMessage=$text; tasks=$tasks; audioToken=$audioToken} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path "C:\Jarvis\orb\status.json" -Encoding UTF8

Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationCore
$probe = New-Object System.Windows.Media.MediaPlayer
$probe.Open([Uri]$mp3Path)
$timeout = 0
while (-not $probe.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan -and $timeout -lt 50) {
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
  $timeout++
}
$duration = 3
if ($probe.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan) { $duration = $probe.NaturalDuration.TimeSpan.TotalSeconds }
$probe.Close()

Start-Sleep -Seconds $duration

@{status="idle"; lastMessage=$text; tasks=$tasks; audioToken=$audioToken} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path "C:\Jarvis\orb\status.json" -Encoding UTF8
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\.claude\hooks\speak-response.ps1 -Encoding UTF8
```

```powershell
let globeScene, globeCamera, globeRenderer, globeMesh;
function initGlobe() {
  const container = document.getElementById("globeContainer");
  globeScene = new THREE.Scene();
  globeCamera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 0.1, 100);
  globeCamera.position.z = 3.2;
  globeRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ alpha: true, antialias: true });
  globeRenderer.setSize(150, 150);
  container.appendChild(globeRenderer.domElement);
  const loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
  loader.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
  const earthTexture = loader.load("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/dev/examples/textures/planets/earth_atmos_2048.jpg");
  const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.2, 32, 24);
  const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: earthTexture });
  globeMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  globeScene.add(globeMesh);
  const wireGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.22, 24, 16);
  const wireMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x5affe6, wireframe: true, transparent: true, opacity: 0.2 });
  globeScene.add(new THREE.Mesh(wireGeo, wireMat));
  const atmosGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.3, 24, 16);
  const atmosMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x5affe6, transparent: true, opacity: 0.08 });
  globeScene.add(new THREE.Mesh(atmosGeo, atmosMat));
  animateGlobe();
}
function animateGlobe() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animateGlobe);
  globeMesh.rotation.y += 0.006;
  globeRenderer.render(globeScene, globeCamera);
}
if (window.THREE) initGlobe();

const stage = document.getElementById("stage");
document.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  const dx = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5) * 10;
  const dy = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 10;
  stage.style.transform = `translate(calc(-50% + ${dx}px), calc(-50% + ${dy}px))`;
});

async function poll() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("status.json?t=" + Date.now());
    const data = await res.json();
    const label = document.getElementById("label");
    if (data.status === "thinking") {
      currentState = "thinking";
      if (coreParticles) coreParticles.material.color.setHex(0xffcf7f);
      label.textContent = "THINKING";
    } else if (data.status === "speaking") {
      if (coreParticles) coreParticles.material.color.setHex(0xbaffef);
      if (data.audioToken && data.audioToken !== lastAudioToken && audioReady) {
        lastAudioToken = data.audioToken;
        audioEl.src = "latest.mp3?t=" + data.audioToken;
        audioEl.play().catch(() => {});
        currentState = "speaking";
        label.textContent = "RESPONDING";
      }
    } else {
      if (audioEl.paused) {
        currentState = "idle";
        if (coreParticles) coreParticles.material.color.setHex(0x5affe6);
        label.textContent = "READY";
      }
    }
    typewrite(data.lastMessage || "—");
    const list = document.getElementById("tasklist"); list.innerHTML = "";
    const tasks = data.tasks || [];
    if (tasks.length > 0) tasks.forEach(t => { const li = document.createElement("li"); li.textContent = t; list.appendChild(li); });
    else list.innerHTML = "<li>none</li>";
  } catch (e) {}
  setTimeout(poll, 400);
}
poll();
</script>
```

```powershell
$output = @{

}
```

**2. Create the backend** that runs Claude Code and edge-tts on request

```powershell
@'
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, send_from_directory
import subprocess, os, time

app = Flask(__name__, static_folder=".", static_url_path="")
TASKS_PATH = r"C:\Jarvis\TASKS.md"

@app.route("/")
def index():
    return send_from_directory(".", "index.html")

def get_open_tasks():
    tasks = []
    if os.path.exists(TASKS_PATH):
        with open(TASKS_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line.startswith("- [ ]"):
                    tasks.append(line[5:].strip())
    return tasks

@app.route("/chat", methods=["POST"])
def chat():
    data = request.get_json()
    message = data.get("message", "")
    if not message:
        return jsonify({"error": "empty"}), 400

    result = subprocess.run(
        ["cmd", "/c", "claude", "-p", message, "-c", "--permission-mode", "acceptEdits"],
        cwd=r"C:\Jarvis", capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=120
    )
    reply = result.stdout.strip() or "Sorry, I could not process that."

    txt_path = os.path.join(os.environ.get("TEMP", "."), "jarvis-response.txt")
    with open(txt_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(reply)
    mp3_path = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\latest.mp3"
    subprocess.run(
        ["cmd", "/c", "edge-tts", "--voice", "en-GB-RyanNeural", "--rate=-2%", "--file", txt_path, "--write-media", mp3_path],
        timeout=60
    )

    return jsonify({"reply": reply, "audioToken": str(int(time.time() * 1000)), "tasks": get_open_tasks()})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(port=8420)
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\orb\app.py -Encoding UTF8
```

**3. Add the text box + mic button to the page** — insert this right before `</body>` (open the file and add manually, or use the command below):

```powershell
$chatUi = @'

<script>
async function sendMessage(text) {
  if (!text || !text.trim()) return;
  currentState = "thinking";
  document.getElementById("label").textContent = "THINKING";
  if (coreParticles) coreParticles.material.color.setHex(0xffcf7f);
  try {
    const res = await fetch("/chat", { method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({message: text}) });
    const data = await res.json();
    typewrite(data.reply || "no reply");
    if (data.tasks) {
      const list = document.getElementById("tasklist"); list.innerHTML = "";
      if (data.tasks.length > 0) data.tasks.forEach(t => { const li=document.createElement("li"); li.textContent=t; list.appendChild(li); });
      else list.innerHTML = "<li>none</li>";
    }
    currentState = "speaking";
    document.getElementById("label").textContent = "RESPONDING";
    if (coreParticles) coreParticles.material.color.setHex(0xbaffef);
    lastAudioToken = data.audioToken;
    if (audioReady) { audioEl.src = "latest.mp3?t=" + data.audioToken; audioEl.play().catch(() => {}); }
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById("label").textContent = "ERROR";
  }
}
document.getElementById("sendBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const input = document.getElementById("msgInput");
  sendMessage(input.value);
  input.value = "";
});
document.getElementById("msgInput").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") document.getElementById("sendBtn").click(); });
let recognition;
if ("webkitSpeechRecognition" in window) {
  recognition = new webkitSpeechRecognition();
  recognition.lang = "en-US";
  recognition.onresult = (e) => { const t = e.results[0][0].transcript; document.getElementById("msgInput").value = t; sendMessage(t); };
  document.getElementById("micBtn").addEventListener("click", () => recognition.start());
} else {
  document.getElementById("micBtn").style.display = "none";
}
</script>
```

**1. Update the backend**

```powershell
@'
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, send_from_directory
import subprocess, os, time, json

app = Flask(__name__, static_folder=".", static_url_path="")
TASKS_PATH = r"C:\Jarvis\TASKS.md"
STATUS_PATH = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\status.json"

def get_open_tasks():
    tasks = []
    if os.path.exists(TASKS_PATH):
        with open(TASKS_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line.startswith("- [ ]"):
                    tasks.append(line[5:].strip())
    return tasks

def write_status(status, message, tasks, token):
    with open(STATUS_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"status": status, "lastMessage": message, "tasks": tasks, "audioToken": token}, f)

@app.route("/")
def index():
    return send_from_directory(".", "index.html")

@app.route("/chat", methods=["POST"])
def chat():
    data = request.get_json()
    message = data.get("message", "")
    if not message:
        return jsonify({"error": "empty"}), 400

    tasks = get_open_tasks()
    write_status("thinking", "", tasks, None)

    result = subprocess.run(
        ["cmd", "/c", "claude", "-p", message, "--permission-mode", "acceptEdits"],
        cwd=r"C:\Jarvis", capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=120
    )
    reply = result.stdout.strip() or "Sorry, I could not process that."

    txt_path = os.path.join(os.environ.get("TEMP", "."), "jarvis-response.txt")
    with open(txt_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(reply)
    mp3_path = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\latest.mp3"
    subprocess.run(
        ["cmd", "/c", "edge-tts", "--voice", "en-GB-RyanNeural", "--rate=-2%", "--file", txt_path, "--write-media", mp3_path],
        timeout=60
    )

    token = str(int(time.time() * 1000))
    tasks = get_open_tasks()
    write_status("speaking", reply, tasks, token)

    return jsonify({"reply": reply, "audioToken": token, "tasks": tasks})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(port=8420)
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\orb\app.py -Encoding UTF8
```

```powershell
      else list.innerHTML = "<li>none</li>";

    currentState = "speaking";
    document.getElementById("label").textContent = "RESPONDING";
    if (coreParticles) coreParticles.material.color.setHex(0xbaffef);

    document.getElementById("label").textContent = "ERROR";
  }
}

}
```

```powershell
@'
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, send_from_directory
import subprocess, os, time, json, socket

app = Flask(__name__, static_folder=".", static_url_path="")
TASKS_PATH = r"C:\Jarvis\TASKS.md"
STATUS_PATH = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\status.json"
SESSION_MARKER = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\webchat_session_created.flag"
WEBCHAT_SESSION_ID = "8f14e45f-ceea-467e-9575-5c3c4a5c6f2b"

def get_open_tasks():
    tasks = []
    if os.path.exists(TASKS_PATH):
        with open(TASKS_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line.startswith("- [ ]"):
                    tasks.append(line[5:].strip())
    return tasks

def write_status(status, message, tasks, token):
    with open(STATUS_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"status": status, "lastMessage": message, "tasks": tasks, "audioToken": token}, f)

def run_claude(message):
    if os.path.exists(SESSION_MARKER):
        cmd = ["cmd", "/c", "claude", "-p", message, "--permission-mode", "acceptEdits", "--resume", WEBCHAT_SESSION_ID]
    else:
        cmd = ["cmd", "/c", "claude", "-p", message, "--permission-mode", "acceptEdits", "--session-id", WEBCHAT_SESSION_ID]
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=r"C:\Jarvis", capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=120)
    if result.returncode != 0 and result.stderr.strip():
        raise RuntimeError(result.stderr.strip()[:300])
    if not os.path.exists(SESSION_MARKER):
        with open(SESSION_MARKER, "w") as f:
            f.write("created")
    return result.stdout.strip() or "Sorry, I could not process that."

@app.route("/")
def index():
    return send_from_directory(".", "index.html")

@app.route("/chat", methods=["POST"])
def chat():
    data = request.get_json()
    message = data.get("message", "")
    if not message:
        return jsonify({"error": "empty"}), 400

    tasks = get_open_tasks()
    write_status("thinking", "", tasks, None)

    try:
        reply = run_claude(message)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        write_status("idle", "Sorry, that request timed out.", tasks, None)
        return jsonify({"error": "timeout"}), 504
    except Exception as e:
        write_status("idle", "Something went wrong: " + str(e), tasks, None)
        return jsonify({"error": str(e)}), 500

    write_status("speaking", reply, tasks, None)

    token = None
    try:
        txt_path = os.path.join(os.environ.get("TEMP", "."), "jarvis-response.txt")
        with open(txt_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(reply)
        mp3_path = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\latest.mp3"
        subprocess.run(
            ["cmd", "/c", "edge-tts", "--voice", "en-GB-RyanNeural", "--rate=-2%", "--file", txt_path, "--write-media", mp3_path],
            timeout=30
        )
        token = str(int(time.time() * 1000))
    except Exception:
        pass

    tasks = get_open_tasks()
    write_status("speaking" if token else "idle", reply, tasks, token)

    return jsonify({"reply": reply, "audioToken": token, "tasks": tasks})

def port_in_use(port):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        return s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", port)) == 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if port_in_use(8420):
        print("Port 8420 is already in use by another process. Stop it first (check for a stray python.exe) before starting a new instance.")
    else:
        app.run(port=8420)
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\orb\app.py -Encoding UTF8
```

**2. Update `app.py` to log history from web-chat replies too**

```powershell
@'
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, send_from_directory
import subprocess, os, time, json, socket

app = Flask(__name__, static_folder=".", static_url_path="")
TASKS_PATH = r"C:\Jarvis\TASKS.md"
STATUS_PATH = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\status.json"
HISTORY_PATH = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\history.json"
SESSION_MARKER = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\webchat_session_created.flag"
WEBCHAT_SESSION_ID = "8f14e45f-ceea-467e-9575-5c3c4a5c6f2b"

def get_open_tasks():
    tasks = []
    if os.path.exists(TASKS_PATH):
        with open(TASKS_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line.startswith("- [ ]"):
                    tasks.append(line[5:].strip())
    return tasks

def write_status(status, message, tasks, token):
    with open(STATUS_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"status": status, "lastMessage": message, "tasks": tasks, "audioToken": token}, f)

def add_history(text):
    history = []
    if os.path.exists(HISTORY_PATH):
        try:
            with open(HISTORY_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as f:
                history = json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            history = []
    short = text if len(text) <= 80 else text[:80] + "..."
    history.append({"time": time.strftime("%H:%M"), "text": short})
    history = history[-10:]
    with open(HISTORY_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(history, f)

def run_claude(message):
    if os.path.exists(SESSION_MARKER):
        cmd = ["cmd", "/c", "claude", "-p", message, "--permission-mode", "acceptEdits", "--resume", WEBCHAT_SESSION_ID]
    else:
        cmd = ["cmd", "/c", "claude", "-p", message, "--permission-mode", "acceptEdits", "--session-id", WEBCHAT_SESSION_ID]
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=r"C:\Jarvis", capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=120)
    if result.returncode != 0 and result.stderr.strip():
        raise RuntimeError(result.stderr.strip()[:300])
    if not os.path.exists(SESSION_MARKER):
        with open(SESSION_MARKER, "w") as f:
            f.write("created")
    return result.stdout.strip() or "Sorry, I could not process that."

@app.route("/")
def index():
    return send_from_directory(".", "index.html")

@app.route("/chat", methods=["POST"])
def chat():
    data = request.get_json()
    message = data.get("message", "")
    if not message:
        return jsonify({"error": "empty"}), 400

    tasks = get_open_tasks()
    write_status("thinking", "", tasks, None)

    try:
        reply = run_claude(message)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        write_status("idle", "Sorry, that request timed out.", tasks, None)
        return jsonify({"error": "timeout"}), 504
    except Exception as e:
        write_status("idle", "Something went wrong: " + str(e), tasks, None)
        return jsonify({"error": str(e)}), 500

    add_history(reply)
    write_status("speaking", reply, tasks, None)

    token = None
    try:
        txt_path = os.path.join(os.environ.get("TEMP", "."), "jarvis-response.txt")
        with open(txt_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(reply)
        mp3_path = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\latest.mp3"
        subprocess.run(
            ["cmd", "/c", "edge-tts", "--voice", "en-GB-RyanNeural", "--rate=-2%", "--file", txt_path, "--write-media", mp3_path],
            timeout=30
        )
        token = str(int(time.time() * 1000))
    except Exception:
        pass

    tasks = get_open_tasks()
    write_status("speaking" if token else "idle", reply, tasks, token)

    return jsonify({"reply": reply, "audioToken": token, "tasks": tasks})

def port_in_use(port):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        return s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", port)) == 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if port_in_use(8420):
        print("Port 8420 is already in use by another process. Stop it first (check for a stray python.exe) before starting a new instance.")
    else:
        app.run(port=8420)
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\orb\app.py -Encoding UTF8
```

**3. A sync script that turns the markdown into a JSON graph the dashboard can read**

```powershell
@'
$projectsPath = "C:\Jarvis\knowledge\PROJECTS.md"
$tasksPath = "C:\Jarvis\TASKS.md"
$outPath = "C:\Jarvis\orb\knowledge.json"

$agents = @("researcher","coder","debugger","business-analyst","writer","planner","webdesigner","project-manager")

$projects = @()
if (Test-Path $projectsPath) {
    $lines = Get-Content $projectsPath
    $current = $null
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        if ($line -match "^##\s+(.+)") {
            if ($current) { $projects += $current }
            $current = @{ name = $matches[1].Trim(); status = "unknown"; owner = "" }
        } elseif ($current -and $line -match "^-\s*Status:\s*(.+)") {
            $current.status = $matches[1].Trim()
        } elseif ($current -and $line -match "^-\s*Owner agent:\s*(.+)") {
            $current.owner = $matches[1].Trim()
        }
    }
    if ($current) { $projects += $current }
}

$tasks = @()
if (Test-Path $tasksPath) {
    Get-Content $tasksPath | Where-Object { $_ -match "^\s*-\s*\[ \]" } | ForEach-Object {
        $line = $_ -replace "^\s*-\s*\[ \]\s*", ""
        $project = ""
        if ($line -match "#([\w-]+)") { $project = $matches[1] }
        $tasks += @{ text = $line; project = $project }
    }
}

@{ agents = $agents; projects = $projects; tasks = $tasks } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content -Path $outPath -Encoding UTF8
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\.claude\hooks\sync-knowledge.ps1 -Encoding UTF8
```

```powershell
$content = Get-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\orb\index.html -Raw

$orbitHtml = '<div id="orbitRing" style="position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; pointer-events:none;"></div>'
$content = $content -replace '(<div id="coreContainer"></div>)', ($orbitHtml + "`n" + '$1')

$orbitScript = @'
const AGENTS = ["researcher","coder","debugger","business-analyst","writer","planner","webdesigner","project-manager"];
function renderAgentRing() {
  const ring = document.getElementById("orbitRing");
  ring.innerHTML = "";
  const radius = 130;
  AGENTS.forEach((name, i) => {
    const angle = (i / AGENTS.length) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2;
    const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius, y = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
    const dot = document.createElement("div");
    dot.style.cssText = "position:absolute; top:calc(50% + " + y + "px); left:calc(50% + " + x + "px); transform:translate(-50%,-50%); width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:#5affe6; box-shadow:0 0 6px 2px rgba(90,255,230,0.5);";
    ring.appendChild(dot);
    const label = document.createElement("div");
    label.textContent = name;
    label.style.cssText = "position:absolute; top:calc(50% + " + (y * 1.32) + "px); left:calc(50% + " + (x * 1.32) + "px); transform:translate(-50%,-50%); font-size:8px; opacity:0.4; white-space:nowrap; letter-spacing:1px; color:#7fffe8;";
    ring.appendChild(label);
  });
}
renderAgentRing();

async function pollKnowledge() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("knowledge.json?t=" + Date.now());
    const data = await res.json();
    document.querySelectorAll(".proj-dot,.proj-label").forEach(el => el.remove());
    const ring = document.getElementById("orbitRing");
    const outerRadius = 190;
    (data.projects || []).forEach((p, i) => {
      const total = Math.max(data.projects.length, 1);
      const angle = (i / total) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2;
      const x = Math.cos(angle) * outerRadius, y = Math.sin(angle) * outerRadius;
      const dot = document.createElement("div");
      dot.className = "proj-dot";
      dot.style.cssText = "position:absolute; top:calc(50% + " + y + "px); left:calc(50% + " + x + "px); transform:translate(-50%,-50%); width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:#ffcf7f; box-shadow:0 0 8px 3px rgba(255,207,127,0.5);";
      ring.appendChild(dot);
      const label = document.createElement("div");
      label.className = "proj-label";
      label.textContent = p.name;
      label.style.cssText = "position:absolute; top:calc(50% + " + (y * 1.18) + "px); left:calc(50% + " + (x * 1.18) + "px); transform:translate(-50%,-50%); font-size:9px; opacity:0.6; white-space:nowrap; color:#ffcf7f;";
      ring.appendChild(label);
    });
  } catch (e) {}
}
setInterval(pollKnowledge, 5000);
pollKnowledge();
'@

Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\orb\index.html -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
```

**The core idea:** what you're describing is a **knowledge graph / node-link visualization** — a well-established way to show how AI agents, entities, and relationships connect. Two things make these visualizations feel "alive" and interconnected rather than just decorative:

**1. Actual connecting lines, not just floating dots.** In real implementations, nodes represent entities (agents, projects, people, data) and edges represent explicit relationships between them — typically labeled with what the relationship *is* ("owns," "depends on," "feeds into"), with line thickness often showing how strong that relationship is. Our current orbit has agents and projects as separate rings, but nothing actually connecting a project to the agent that owns it — that's the missing piece that would make it read as a real graph instead of two decorative circles.

**2. Force-directed layout instead of fixed positions.** A common pattern lets users click on any node in the graph to open its profile and update the entire dashboard, letting people visually follow connections by hopping between them. Rather than evenly spacing nodes on a ring, related things naturally cluster closer together and unrelated things drift apart — which is a big part of why those videos look "alive" instead of static.

**3. Color still encodes type, size can encode importance.** We already color agents vs. projects differently, which matches the pattern — real implementations often also size a node by how central/connected it is.

The knowledge graph panel will be a fixed 260x220px container in the top-left with a canvas inside, labeled "KNOWLEDGE", and I'll apply transform scaling and translation to the canvas context for the zoom and pan interactions scoped to just that panel.

The node types are agents (fixed cyan positions), projects (amber), and tasks (small, dimmer, connected to their parent project), with edges connecting projects to their owner agents and tasks to their projects. I'm pulling the node data from knowledge.json and fetching it periodically, merging updates into a persistent simulation state so nodes retain their positions between refreshes.

Now I'm setting up the simulation data structures and sync logic—tracking existing nodes by ID, adding new agents/projects/tasks as they appear in the data, and removing nodes that are no longer present. Building the knowledge graph nodes... Implementing force-directed graph physics... Writing the canvas rendering... Finishing the text rendering with font styling, then setting up the animation loop that continuously steps and renders the graph. I'm also adding a polling mechanism that fetches updated knowledge data every five seconds, and wiring up canvas interactions for zooming with the mouse wheel and panning by dragging.

Now I need to clean up the old orbit ring approach that we're replacing with this new panel, so I'll remove the orbitRing div and its associated functions, then reposition the Activity panel below the graph instead of in the top-left. I'll shift Activity down to make room for the Knowledge graph panel above it in the top-left corner, then do a complete rewrite of the index.html file with all the panels positioned correctly—Knowledge graph and Activity stacked on the left, datetime and tasks across the top, log and globe on the bottom, the core sphere centered, and all the existing scripts integrated.

Writing the complete HTML file...Good idea — a proper zoomable mini-map feels much more like an actual "brain" than dots on a ring. Let's build it as a self-contained canvas panel: scroll to zoom, drag to pan, nodes push apart and pull together naturally (a lightweight physics simulation), edges show real connections.

```powershell
<script>
function updateClock() {
  const now = new Date();
  document.getElementById("clock").textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString();
  document.getElementById("dateline").textContent = now.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: "short", year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}
updateClock(); setInterval(updateClock, 1000);

let lastRenderedMessage = "";
function typewrite(text) {
  if (text === lastRenderedMessage) return;
  lastRenderedMessage = text;
  const el = document.getElementById("chatlog"); el.textContent = "";
  let i = 0;
  function step() { if (i <= text.length) { el.textContent = text.slice(0, i); i += 3; setTimeout(step, 12); } }
  step();
}

let audioCtx, analyser, freqData, audioReady = false;
const audioEl = new Audio();
audioEl.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
function setupAudio() {
  if (audioReady) return;
  audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  const source = audioCtx.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
  analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
  analyser.fftSize = 128;
  freqData = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
  source.connect(analyser);
  analyser.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  audioReady = true;
}
document.addEventListener("click", setupAudio, { once: true });
audioEl.addEventListener("ended", () => { currentState = "idle"; document.getElementById("label").textContent = "READY"; });
function getAudioAmplitude() {
  if (!analyser) return 0;
  analyser.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < freqData.length; i++) sum += freqData[i];
  return (sum / freqData.length) / 255;
}

let coreScene, coreCamera, coreRenderer, coreParticles, basePositions;
let speakTime = 0;
let currentState = "idle";
let lastAudioToken = null;
function initCore() {
  const container = document.getElementById("coreContainer");
  coreScene = new THREE.Scene();
  coreCamera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 0.1, 100);
  coreCamera.position.z = 3.2;
  coreRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ alpha: true, antialias: true });
  coreRenderer.setSize(200, 200);
  container.appendChild(coreRenderer.domElement);
  const count = 4500;
  basePositions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
  const radius = 1.15;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const y = 1 - (i / (count - 1)) * 2;
    const r = Math.sqrt(1 - y * y);
    const theta = Math.PI * (1 + Math.sqrt(5)) * i;
    const x = Math.cos(theta) * r;
    const z = Math.sin(theta) * r;
    const jitter = 1 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08;
    basePositions[i*3] = x * radius * jitter;
    basePositions[i*3+1] = y * radius * jitter;
    basePositions[i*3+2] = z * radius * jitter;
  }
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(basePositions.slice(), 3));
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = 16; canvas.height = 16;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(8,8,0,8,8,8);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad; ctx.fillRect(0,0,16,16);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ size: 0.05, map: tex, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, color: 0x5affe6, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending });
  coreParticles = new THREE.Points(geo, mat);
  coreScene.add(coreParticles);
  animateCore();
}
function animateCore() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animateCore);
  const posAttr = coreParticles.geometry.attributes.position;
  const arr = posAttr.array;
  if (currentState === "speaking") {
    const amp = getAudioAmplitude();
    speakTime += 0.1;
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length / 3; i++) {
      const wobble = 1 + amp * 0.22 * Math.sin(speakTime * 2 + i * 0.3);
      arr[i*3] = basePositions[i*3] * wobble;
      arr[i*3+1] = basePositions[i*3+1] * wobble;
      arr[i*3+2] = basePositions[i*3+2] * wobble;
    }
    posAttr.needsUpdate = true;
    coreParticles.rotation.y += 0.006 + amp * 0.02;
  } else if (currentState === "thinking") {
    speakTime += 0.05;
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length / 3; i++) {
      const wobble = 1 + Math.sin(speakTime * 1.5 + i * 0.2) * 0.03;
      arr[i*3] = basePositions[i*3] * wobble;
      arr[i*3+1] = basePositions[i*3+1] * wobble;
      arr[i*3+2] = basePositions[i*3+2] * wobble;
    }
    posAttr.needsUpdate = true;
    coreParticles.rotation.y += 0.005;
  } else {
    if (arr[0] !== basePositions[0]) { arr.set(basePositions); posAttr.needsUpdate = true; }
    coreParticles.rotation.y += 0.003;
  }
  coreRenderer.render(coreScene, coreCamera);
}
if (window.THREE) initCore();

let globeScene, globeCamera, globeRenderer, globeMesh;
function initGlobe() {
  const container = document.getElementById("globeContainer");
  globeScene = new THREE.Scene();
  globeCamera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 0.1, 100);
  globeCamera.position.z = 3.2;
  globeRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ alpha: true, antialias: true });
  globeRenderer.setSize(150, 150);
  container.appendChild(globeRenderer.domElement);
  const loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
  loader.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
  const earthTexture = loader.load("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/dev/examples/textures/planets/earth_atmos_2048.jpg");
  const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.2, 32, 24);
  const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: earthTexture });
  globeMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  globeScene.add(globeMesh);
  const wireGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.22, 24, 16);
  const wireMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x5affe6, wireframe: true, transparent: true, opacity: 0.2 });
  globeScene.add(new THREE.Mesh(wireGeo, wireMat));
  const atmosGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.3, 24, 16);
  const atmosMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x5affe6, transparent: true, opacity: 0.08 });
  globeScene.add(new THREE.Mesh(atmosGeo, atmosMat));
  animateGlobe();
}
function animateGlobe() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animateGlobe);
  globeMesh.rotation.y += 0.006;
  globeRenderer.render(globeScene, globeCamera);
}
if (window.THREE) initGlobe();

const stage = document.getElementById("stage");
document.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  const dx = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5) * 10;
  const dy = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 10;
  stage.style.transform = `translate(calc(-50% + ${dx}px), calc(-50% + ${dy}px))`;
});

let kgNodes = [];
let kgEdges = [];
function kgSyncData(data) {
  const wantIds = new Set();
  const existing = {};
  kgNodes.forEach(n => existing[n.id] = n);

  (data.agents || []).forEach((name, i) => {
    const id = "agent:" + name;
    wantIds.add(id);
    if (!existing[id]) {
      const angle = (i / data.agents.length) * Math.PI * 2;
      kgNodes.push({ id, type: "agent", label: name, x: 50 * Math.cos(angle), y: 50 * Math.sin(angle), vx: 0, vy: 0, radius: 5, color: "#5affe6" });
    }
  });
  (data.projects || []).forEach((p) => {
    const id = "project:" + p.name;
    wantIds.add(id);
    if (!existing[id]) {
      kgNodes.push({ id, type: "project", label: p.name, owner: p.owner, x: (Math.random()-0.5)*80, y: (Math.random()-0.5)*80, vx: 0, vy: 0, radius: 7, color: "#ffcf7f" });
    }
  });
  (data.tasks || []).forEach((t, i) => {
    if (!t.project) return;
    const id = "task:" + t.text;
    wantIds.add(id);
    if (!existing[id]) {
      kgNodes.push({ id, type: "task", label: t.text.slice(0, 20), project: t.project, x: (Math.random()-0.5)*80, y: (Math.random()-0.5)*80, vx: 0, vy: 0, radius: 3, color: "#7fffe8" });
    }
  });
  kgNodes = kgNodes.filter(n => wantIds.has(n.id));

  kgEdges = [];
  kgNodes.forEach(n => {
    if (n.type === "project" && n.owner) {
      const ownerNode = kgNodes.find(a => a.id === "agent:" + n.owner);
      if (ownerNode) kgEdges.push({ source: n.id, target: ownerNode.id });
    }
    if (n.type === "task" && n.project) {
      const projNode = kgNodes.find(p => p.type === "project" && p.label === n.project);
      if (projNode) kgEdges.push({ source: n.id, target: projNode.id });
    }
  });
}
function kgStep() {
  for (let i = 0; i < kgNodes.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < kgNodes.length; j++) {
      const a = kgNodes[i], b = kgNodes[j];
      const dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y;
      const distSq = Math.max(dx*dx + dy*dy, 25);
      const force = 350 / distSq;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
      const fx = dx/dist*force, fy = dy/dist*force;
      a.vx += fx; a.vy += fy;
      b.vx -= fx; b.vy -= fy;
    }
  }
  kgEdges.forEach(e => {
    const a = kgNodes.find(n => n.id === e.source), b = kgNodes.find(n => n.id === e.target);
    if (!a || !b) return;
    const dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) || 0.01;
    const force = (dist - 40) * 0.02;
    const fx = dx/dist*force, fy = dy/dist*force;
    a.vx += fx; a.vy += fy;
    b.vx -= fx; b.vy -= fy;
  });
  kgNodes.forEach(n => {
    n.vx += -n.x * 0.0008;
    n.vy += -n.y * 0.0008;
    n.vx *= 0.85; n.vy *= 0.85;
    n.x += n.vx; n.y += n.vy;
  });
}
let kgScale = 1, kgOffsetX = 0, kgOffsetY = 0, kgDragging = false, kgLastX = 0, kgLastY = 0;
function kgRender() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("kgCanvas");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(canvas.width/2 + kgOffsetX, canvas.height/2 + kgOffsetY);
  ctx.scale(kgScale, kgScale);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,255,230,0.25)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1 / kgScale;
  kgEdges.forEach(e => {
    const a = kgNodes.find(n => n.id === e.source), b = kgNodes.find(n => n.id === e.target);
    if (!a || !b) return;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y); ctx.stroke();
  });
  kgNodes.forEach(n => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(n.x, n.y, n.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = n.color;
    ctx.fill();
    if (kgScale > 0.6) {
      ctx.font = (9 / Math.max(kgScale, 1)) + "px Orbitron";
      ctx.fillText(n.label, n.x + n.radius + 3, n.y + 3);
    }
  });
  ctx.restore();
}
function kgLoop() { kgStep(); kgRender(); requestAnimationFrame(kgLoop); }
kgLoop();
async function pollKG() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("knowledge.json?t=" + Date.now());
    const data = await res.json();
    kgSyncData(data);
  } catch (e) {}
}
setInterval(pollKG, 5000);
pollKG();
const kgCanvasEl = document.getElementById("kgCanvas");
kgCanvasEl.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  kgScale *= (e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9);
  kgScale = Math.max(0.3, Math.min(4, kgScale));
});
kgCanvasEl.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => { kgDragging = true; kgLastX = e.clientX; kgLastY = e.clientY; kgCanvasEl.style.cursor = "grabbing"; });
window.addEventListener("mouseup", () => { kgDragging = false; kgCanvasEl.style.cursor = "grab"; });
window.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  if (!kgDragging) return;
  kgOffsetX += e.clientX - kgLastX;
  kgOffsetY += e.clientY - kgLastY;
  kgLastX = e.clientX; kgLastY = e.clientY;
});

async function pollHistory() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("history.json?t=" + Date.now());
    const hist = await res.json();
    const list = document.getElementById("activitylist");
    list.innerHTML = "";
    if (hist && hist.length > 0) {
      hist.slice().reverse().forEach(h => {
        const li = document.createElement("li");
        li.textContent = "[" + h.time + "] " + h.text;
        list.appendChild(li);
      });
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}
setInterval(pollHistory, 2000);
pollHistory();

async function sendMessage(text) {
  if (!text || !text.trim()) return;
  document.getElementById("label").textContent = "THINKING";
  try {
    await fetch("/chat", { method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({message: text}) });
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById("label").textContent = "ERROR";
  }
}
document.getElementById("sendBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const input = document.getElementById("msgInput");
  sendMessage(input.value);
  input.value = "";
});
document.getElementById("msgInput").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") document.getElementById("sendBtn").click(); });
let recognition;
if ("webkitSpeechRecognition" in window) {
  recognition = new webkitSpeechRecognition();
  recognition.lang = "en-US";
  recognition.onresult = (e) => { const t = e.results[0][0].transcript; document.getElementById("msgInput").value = t; sendMessage(t); };
  document.getElementById("micBtn").addEventListener("click", () => recognition.start());
} else {
  document.getElementById("micBtn").style.display = "none";
}

async function poll() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("status.json?t=" + Date.now());
    const data = await res.json();
    const coreEl = document.getElementById("coreContainer");
    const label = document.getElementById("label");
    if (data.status === "thinking") {
      coreEl.style.animationDuration = "0.8s";
      if (coreParticles) coreParticles.material.color.setHex(0xffcf7f);
      currentState = "thinking";
      label.textContent = "THINKING";
    } else if (data.status === "speaking") {
      if (coreParticles) coreParticles.material.color.setHex(0xbaffef);
      if (data.audioToken && data.audioToken !== lastAudioToken && audioReady) {
        lastAudioToken = data.audioToken;
        audioEl.src = "latest.mp3?t=" + data.audioToken;
        audioEl.play().catch(() => {});
        currentState = "speaking";
        label.textContent = "RESPONDING";
      }
    } else {
      if (audioEl.paused) {
        currentState = "idle";
        if (coreParticles) coreParticles.material.color.setHex(0x5affe6);
        label.textContent = "READY";
      }
    }
    typewrite(data.lastMessage || "—");
    const list = document.getElementById("tasklist"); list.innerHTML = "";
    const tasks = data.tasks || [];
    if (tasks.length > 0) tasks.forEach(t => { const li = document.createElement("li"); li.textContent = t; list.appendChild(li); });
    else list.innerHTML = "<li>none</li>";
  } catch (e) {}
  setTimeout(poll, 400);
}
poll();
</script>
</body>
```

```powershell
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, send_from_directory
import subprocess, os, time, json, socket

app = Flask(__name__, static_folder=".", static_url_path="")
TASKS_PATH = r"C:\Jarvis\TASKS.md"
STATUS_PATH = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\status.json"
HISTORY_PATH = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\history.json"
SESSION_MARKER = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\webchat_session_created.flag"
WEBCHAT_SESSION_ID = "8f14e45f-ceea-467e-9575-5c3c4a5c6f2b"
SECRET_TOKEN = "SECRET_TOKEN_PLACEHOLDER"

def get_open_tasks():
    tasks = []
    if os.path.exists(TASKS_PATH):
        with open(TASKS_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line.startswith("- [ ]"):
                    tasks.append(line[5:].strip())
    return tasks

def write_status(status, message, tasks, token):
    with open(STATUS_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"status": status, "lastMessage": message, "tasks": tasks, "audioToken": token}, f)

def add_history(text):
    history = []
    if os.path.exists(HISTORY_PATH):
        try:
            with open(HISTORY_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as f:
                history = json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            history = []
    short = text if len(text) <= 80 else text[:80] + "..."
    history.append({"time": time.strftime("%H:%M"), "text": short})
    history = history[-10:]
    with open(HISTORY_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(history, f)

def run_claude(message):
    if os.path.exists(SESSION_MARKER):
        cmd = ["cmd", "/c", "claude", "-p", message, "--permission-mode", "acceptEdits", "--resume", WEBCHAT_SESSION_ID]
    else:

@app.before_request
def check_origin():
    if request.path == "/chat":
        origin = request.headers.get("Origin", "")
        if origin and not origin.startswith("http://localhost:8420") and not origin.startswith("http://127.0.0.1:8420"):
            return jsonify({"error": "forbidden"}), 403

@app.route("/")

@app.route("/chat", methods=["POST"])
def chat():
    token = request.headers.get("X-Jarvis-Token", "")
    if token != SECRET_TOKEN:
        return jsonify({"error": "unauthorized"}), 401

    data = request.get_json()
    message = data.get("message", "")
    if not message:
        return jsonify({"error": "empty"}), 400

    tasks = get_open_tasks()
    write_status("thinking", "", tasks, None)

    try:
        reply = run_claude(message)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        write_status("idle", "Sorry, that request timed out.", tasks, None)
        return jsonify({"error": "timeout"}), 504
    except Exception as e:
        write_status("idle", "Something went wrong: " + str(e), tasks, None)
        return jsonify({"error": str(e)}), 500

    add_history(reply)
    write_status("speaking", reply, tasks, None)

    audio_token = None
    try:
        txt_path = os.path.join(os.environ.get("TEMP", "."), "jarvis-response.txt")
        with open(txt_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(reply)
        mp3_path = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\latest.mp3"
        subprocess.run(
            ["cmd", "/c", "edge-tts", "--voice", "en-GB-RyanNeural", "--rate=-2%", "--file", txt_path, "--write-media", mp3_path],
            timeout=30
        )
        audio_token = str(int(time.time() * 1000))
    except Exception:
        pass

    tasks = get_open_tasks()
    write_status("speaking" if audio_token else "idle", reply, tasks, audio_token)

    return jsonify({"reply": reply, "audioToken": audio_token, "tasks": tasks})

def port_in_use(port):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        return s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", port)) == 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if port_in_use(8420):
        print("Port 8420 is already in use. Stop the other instance first.")
    else:
        app.run(host="127.0.0.1", port=8420)
```

```powershell
    Register-ObjectEvent -InputObject $watcher -EventName Deleted -Action { Invoke-KnowledgeSync } | Out-Null
```

```powershell
    history.append({"time": time.strftime("%H:%M"), "text": short})
```
