```powershell
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        write_status("idle", "Sorry, that request timed out.", tasks, None)
        return jsonify({"error": "timeout"}), 504
    except Exception as e:
        write_status("idle", "Something went wrong: " + str(e), tasks, None)
        return jsonify({"error": str(e)}), 500

    add_history(reply)
    write_status("speaking", reply, tasks, None)

    audio_token = None
    try:
        txt_path = os.path.join(os.environ.get("TEMP", "."), "jarvis-response.txt")
        with open(txt_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(reply)
        mp3_path = r"C:\Jarvis\orb\latest.mp3"
        subprocess.run(
            ["cmd", "/c", "edge-tts", "--voice", "en-GB-RyanNeural", "--rate=-2%", "--file", txt_path, "--write-media", mp3_path],
            timeout=30
        )
        audio_token = str(int(time.time() * 1000))
    except Exception:
        pass

    tasks = get_open_tasks()
    write_status("speaking" if audio_token else "idle", reply, tasks, audio_token)

    threading.Thread(target=background_backup, daemon=True).start()

    return jsonify({"reply": reply, "audioToken": audio_token, "tasks": tasks})

def port_in_use(port):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        return s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", port)) == 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if port_in_use(8420):
        print("Port 8420 is already in use. Stop the other instance first.")
    else:
        app.run(host="127.0.0.1", port=8420)
'@ -replace "SECRET_TOKEN_PLACEHOLDER", $secretToken | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\orb\app.py -Encoding UTF8
```

**1. A hook that inspects every tool call to Outlook/Drive and blocks writes, but explicitly allows calendar creation**
```
This block is not supported on your current device yet.
```

```powershell
@'
$inputJson = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
$data = $inputJson | ConvertFrom-Json
$toolName = $data.tool_name
if (-not $toolName) { exit 0 }
$lower = $toolName.ToLower()

$isConnector = ($lower -match "outlook") -or ($lower -match "gdrive") -or ($lower -match "google_drive") -or ($lower -match "googledrive") -or ($lower -match "drive")

if (-not $isConnector) { exit 0 }

$isCalendarCreate = ($lower -match "calendar") -and (($lower -match "create") -or ($lower -match "add") -or ($lower -match "insert") -or ($lower -match "new") -or ($lower -match "event"))

if ($isCalendarCreate) {
    @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = "PreToolUse"; permissionDecision = "allow"; permissionDecisionReason = "Calendar event creation is explicitly allowed" } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
    exit 0
}

$writeActions = @("send","delete","remove","update","edit","write","modify","move","archive","trash","upload","create","reply","forward")
$isWrite = $false
foreach ($w in $writeActions) { if ($lower -match $w) { $isWrite = $true; break } }

if ($isWrite) {
    @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = "PreToolUse"; permissionDecision = "deny"; permissionDecisionReason = "Outlook and Google Drive are read-only except calendar event creation. This action was blocked by policy." } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
    exit 0
}

exit 0
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\.claude\hooks\guard-connectors.ps1 -Encoding UTF8
```

## Part 1: Register your own free Azure app

1. Go to [portal.azure.com](https://portal.azure.com) and sign in with your personal Microsoft account (the same one you use for Outlook)
2. In the search bar, type **"App registrations"** → click it
3. Click **New registration**
4. Name: `Jarvis Outlook` (anything works)
5. Under **Supported account types**, select **"Personal Microsoft accounts only"**
6. Leave Redirect URI empty — not needed for this flow
7. Click **Register**
8. On the app's page, go to **Authentication** (left sidebar) → **Advanced settings** → set **"Allow public client flows"** to **Yes** → **Save**
9. Go to **API permissions** → **Add a permission** → **Microsoft Graph** → **Delegated permissions** → search and add:
   - `Mail.Read`
   - `Calendars.ReadWrite`
   - `User.Read`
   → click **Add permissions** (no admin consent needed for personal accounts — you'll approve it yourself on first login)
10. Go back to **Overview** and copy the **Application (client) ID** — you'll need this next.

## Part 2: Install the MCP server

```powershell
cd C:\Jarvis
git clone https://github.com/nsakki55/outlook-mcp
cd outlook-mcp
npm install -g pnpm
pnpm install
pnpm build
```

```powershell
}
```

```powershell
@'
# Jarvis — System Documentation

Personal AI assistant built on Claude Code. Lives at `C:\Jarvis`, backed up to `github.com/itzfabu/Javis`.

## Quick start

Double-click `start-everything.bat` (or it runs automatically at login). This opens:
- A minimized knowledge watcher
- A minimized Flask server (the orb/chat backend)
- Your browser at `http://localhost:8420`

Everything happens through that browser tab — type or use the mic button. You don't need a terminal for daily use.

For direct terminal access instead: run `start-jarvis.bat`.

## Folder structure

```
C:\Jarvis\
├── CLAUDE.md              - Core instructions: personality, rules, memory system, startup routine
├── TASKS.md                - Task list: "- [ ] text | priority: x | due: date | #project-tag"
├── knowledge\
│   └── PROJECTS.md          - Project tracker (name, status, owner agent)
├── vault\                   - Obsidian vault (the "second brain")
│   ├── Projects\             - PARA: things with a goal + end date
│   ├── Areas\                - PARA: ongoing responsibilities
│   ├── Resources\            - PARA: reference material
│   │   └── Insights.md        - Weekly auto-generated insight review
│   ├── Archive\               - PARA: inactive items
│   ├── Templates\             - Note templates (enabled in Obsidian's core Templates plugin)
│   └── Decisions-Log.md       - Log of notable decisions and why they were made
├── orb\                      - The web dashboard
│   ├── index.html              - The whole UI: sphere, globe, knowledge graph, chat, tasks
│   ├── app.py                  - Flask backend, handles /chat, runs `claude -p`
│   ├── status.json, history.json, knowledge.json, latest.mp3  - generated, not edited by hand
├── .claude\
│   ├── agents\                - 8 subagents (see below)
│   ├── hooks\                  - Automation scripts (see below)
│   └── settings.json           - Hook registrations
├── start-everything.bat      - Combined launcher (auto-starts at login)
├── start-jarvis.bat          - Terminal-only launcher (manual)
└── .gitignore                - Excludes generated files, secrets, node_modules
```

## Subagents (`.claude/agents/`)

| Agent | Role |
|---|---|
| researcher | Web research, fact-checking, source comparison |
| coder | Writes/refactors code, senior-engineer standards |
| debugger | Systematic bug diagnosis, hypothesis-driven |
| business-analyst | Market/financial analysis, chances vs. risks |
| writer | Professional text editing/formulation |
| planner | Prioritization, scheduling, Chief-of-Staff style |
| webdesigner | UI/web design and implementation |
| project-manager | Coordinates the other 7, checks knowledge/PROJECTS.md first |

All 8 check `knowledge/PROJECTS.md` for context and can save findings into the vault.

## Hooks (`.claude/hooks/`)

| File | Fires on | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| set-thinking.ps1 | UserPromptSubmit | Sets orb status to "thinking" |
| speak-response.ps1 | Stop | Generates voice (edge-tts), updates status.json/history.json. Skips itself for the web-chat session (app.py handles that separately) |
| fetch-context.ps1 | SessionStart | Fetches weather/time/tasks *before* Claude starts, so the greeting doesn't need a live web search |
| git-backup.ps1 | SessionEnd | Commits + pushes to GitHub, then re-runs sync-knowledge.ps1 |
| sync-knowledge.ps1 | (called by others) | Parses PROJECTS.md, TASKS.md, and vault notes into orb/knowledge.json for the graph |
| watch-knowledge.ps1 | (runs continuously) | File-watches knowledge/TASKS.md/vault and re-syncs instantly on any change |
| guard-connectors.ps1 | PreToolUse | Blocks Outlook write actions (send/delete/edit) except calendar event creation |

## The orb dashboard (`orb/index.html`)

- **Center**: particle sphere (Three.js) — teal idle, amber thinking, brighter+rippling while speaking, reacts to real audio amplitude
- **Top-left**: KNOWLEDGE graph (zoomable/pannable, force-directed) — agents, projects, tasks, vault notes as connected nodes; ACTIVITY log below it
- **Top-center**: live clock/date
- **Top-right**: open tasks
- **Bottom-left**: last response text
- **Bottom-right**: rotating wireframe Earth (WORLD)
- **Bottom-center**: chat bar + mic button — talks to Claude via `app.py`'s `/chat` endpoint, which runs `claude -p` in its own dedicated session (separate from your terminal session, so they don't cross-contaminate)

## Connectors & tools

| Tool | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Google Drive | Connected, read/write | Via claude.ai account connector |
| Outlook | Paused | Personal-account OAuth kept failing across multiple tools; parked for now |
| GitHub | Connected | Via `gh` CLI, not an MCP server |
| Playwright | Connected | Browser automation MCP |
| document-skills | Installed | PDF/Excel/Word/PowerPoint (official Anthropic plugin) |
| obsidian-skills | Installed | Teaches proper wikilink/note format |

## Cloud routines (`/schedule` in a terminal session, or claude.ai/code/routines)

| Name | Frequency | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Daily News Brief | Daily 7am | DAILY-BRIEF.md |
| Monthly CLAUDE.md / TASKS.md Staleness Review | Monthly, 1st | REVIEW-NOTES.md |
| Weekly Vault Insights Review | Weekly, Monday | vault/Resources/Insights.md (prepended) |

Note: all cron schedules are fixed UTC — times drift by ~1 hour between summer/winter. Not adjusted, since it doesn't matter for these tasks.

## Security

- The web chat (`app.py`) requires a secret token (`X-Jarvis-Token` header) and rejects requests with a foreign Origin — prevents other websites/tabs from silently triggering actions
- Flask binds to `127.0.0.1` only — not reachable from the network
- `guard-connectors.ps1` technically blocks Outlook writes regardless of what's asked, not just by instruction
- Generated/sensitive files (tokens, session flags, mp3s, status files) are gitignored

## Common gotchas (things that have actually broken before)

- **PowerShell `Get-Content -Raw | ... | Set-Content` round-trips can corrupt umlauts/encoding** on PS 5.1. Prefer having Claude Code edit files directly with its own Edit tool for anything with special characters.
- **JSON paths need forward slashes or double-escaped backslashes** — `C:/Jarvis/...` is safer than `C:\\Jarvis\\...` in settings.json.
- **Starting two `python app.py` instances** silently both bind to port 8420 on Windows without erroring — `app.py` now refuses to start if the port's already in use, but check for stray `python.exe` processes if the orb ever behaves strangely.
- **Any command meant for your own PowerShell window must be run there directly** — pasting local setup commands into a running Claude Code session (terminal or web) doesn't work the same way and can trigger the auto-mode permission classifier.
- **The web chat and terminal sessions are intentionally separate** (different Claude session IDs) so they don't cross-contaminate context or double-fire hooks.

## If everything breaks

1. Everything is backed up to `github.com/itzfabu/Javis` — worst case, `git clone` fresh and reconnect the pieces
2. Check `.claude/settings.json` is valid JSON and all 5 hooks are present
3. Check `orb/app.py` and `watch-knowledge.ps1` aren't both already running before starting fresh copies
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\README.md -Encoding UTF8
```

```powershell
git commit -m "Add system documentation"
```

**3. Update `sync-knowledge.ps1` to parse goals and link projects to them**

```powershell
@'
$projectsPath = "C:\Jarvis\knowledge\PROJECTS.md"
$goalsPath = "C:\Jarvis\knowledge\GOALS.md"
$tasksPath = "C:\Jarvis\TASKS.md"
$outPath = "C:\Jarvis\orb\knowledge.json"

$agents = @("researcher","coder","debugger","business-analyst","writer","planner","webdesigner","project-manager")

$goals = @()
if (Test-Path $goalsPath) {
    $lines = Get-Content $goalsPath
    $current = $null
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        if ($line -match "^##\s+(.+)") {
            if ($current -and $current.name -ne "Goal Name") { $goals += $current }
            $current = @{ name = $matches[1].Trim(); status = "unknown"; timeframe = "" }
        } elseif ($current -and $line -match "^-\s*Status:\s*(.+)") {
            $current.status = $matches[1].Trim()
        } elseif ($current -and $line -match "^-\s*Timeframe:\s*(.+)") {
            $current.timeframe = $matches[1].Trim()
        }
    }
    if ($current -and $current.name -ne "Goal Name") { $goals += $current }
}

$projects = @()
if (Test-Path $projectsPath) {
    $lines = Get-Content $projectsPath
    $current = $null
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        if ($line -match "^##\s+(.+)") {
            if ($current -and $current.name -ne "Project Name") { $projects += $current }
            $current = @{ name = $matches[1].Trim(); status = "unknown"; owner = ""; goal = "" }
        } elseif ($current -and $line -match "^-\s*Status:\s*(.+)") {
            $current.status = $matches[1].Trim()
        } elseif ($current -and $line -match "^-\s*Owner agent:\s*(.+)") {
            $current.owner = $matches[1].Trim()
        } elseif ($current -and $line -match "^-\s*Goal:\s*(.+)") {
            $current.goal = $matches[1].Trim()
        }
    }
    if ($current -and $current.name -ne "Project Name") { $projects += $current }
}

$tasks = @()
if (Test-Path $tasksPath) {
    Get-Content $tasksPath | Where-Object { $_ -match "^\s*-\s*\[ \]" } | ForEach-Object {
        $line = $_ -replace "^\s*-\s*\[ \]\s*", ""
        $project = ""
        if ($line -match "#([\w-]+)") { $project = $matches[1] }
        $tasks += @{ text = $line; project = $project }
    }
}

$notes = @()
$vaultFolders = @("Projects","Areas","Resources")
foreach ($folder in $vaultFolders) {
    $folderPath = "C:\Jarvis\vault\$folder"
    if (Test-Path $folderPath) {
        Get-ChildItem -Path $folderPath -Filter "*.md" -File | ForEach-Object {
            $notes += @{ title = $_.BaseName; folder = $folder }
        }
    }
}

@{ agents = $agents; projects = $projects; tasks = $tasks; notes = $notes; goals = $goals } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content -Path $outPath -Encoding UTF8
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\.claude\hooks\sync-knowledge.ps1 -Encoding UTF8
```

**4. Add goal nodes to the graph** — same safe pattern as the notes addition (a new function, not touching the risky-to-match existing one):

```powershell
$content = Get-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\orb\index.html -Raw

$oldPoll = @'
async function pollKG() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("knowledge.json?t=" + Date.now());
    const data = await res.json();
    kgSyncData(data);
    kgSyncNotes(data.notes || []);
  } catch (e) {}
}
'@

$newPoll = @'
async function pollKG() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("knowledge.json?t=" + Date.now());
    const data = await res.json();
    kgSyncData(data);
    kgSyncNotes(data.notes || []);
    kgSyncGoals(data.goals || [], data.projects || []);
  } catch (e) {}
}

function kgSyncGoals(goals, projects) {
  const wantIds = new Set(kgNodes.filter(n => n.type !== "goal").map(n => n.id));
  const existing = {};
  kgNodes.forEach(n => existing[n.id] = n);
  goals.forEach((g, i) => {
    const id = "goal:" + g.name;
    wantIds.add(id);
    if (!existing[id]) {
      kgNodes.push({ id, type: "goal", label: g.name, x: (Math.random()-0.5)*40, y: (Math.random()-0.5)*40, vx: 0, vy: 0, radius: 9, color: "#ffd27f" });
    }
  });
  kgNodes = kgNodes.filter(n => n.type !== "goal" || wantIds.has(n.id));
  projects.forEach(p => {
    if (!p.goal) return;
    const projNode = kgNodes.find(n => n.type === "project" && n.label === p.name);
    const goalNode = kgNodes.find(n => n.type === "goal" && n.label.toLowerCase() === p.goal.toLowerCase());
    if (projNode && goalNode && !kgEdges.find(e => e.source === projNode.id && e.target === goalNode.id)) {
      kgEdges.push({ source: projNode.id, target: goalNode.id });
    }
  });
}
'@

$content = $content.Replace($oldPoll, $newPoll)
Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\orb\index.html -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
```

```powershell
@'
$projectsPath = "C:\Jarvis\knowledge\PROJECTS.md"
$goalsPath = "C:\Jarvis\knowledge\GOALS.md"
$tasksPath = "C:\Jarvis\TASKS.md"
$outPath = "C:\Jarvis\orb\knowledge.json"
$warningsPath = "C:\Jarvis\orb\knowledge-warnings.json"

$warnings = @()

function Test-SuspiciousHeadingLines($filePath, $label) {
    $result = @()
    if (Test-Path $filePath) {
        $lineNum = 0
        Get-Content $filePath | ForEach-Object {
            $lineNum++
            $line = $_
            if ($line -match "##" -and $line -notmatch "^##\s+\S" -and $line.Trim() -ne "") {
                $result += "$label line $lineNum looks like a malformed heading and will be skipped: '$line'"
            }
        }
    }
    return $result
}

$warnings += Test-SuspiciousHeadingLines $goalsPath "GOALS.md"
$warnings += Test-SuspiciousHeadingLines $projectsPath "PROJECTS.md"

$agents = @("researcher","coder","debugger","business-analyst","writer","planner","webdesigner","project-manager")

$goals = @()
if (Test-Path $goalsPath) {
    $lines = Get-Content $goalsPath
    $current = $null
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        if ($line -match "^##\s+(.+)") {
            if ($current -and $current.name -ne "Goal Name") { $goals += $current }
            $current = @{ name = $matches[1].Trim(); status = "unknown"; timeframe = "" }
        } elseif ($current -and $line -match "^-\s*Status:\s*(.+)") {
            $current.status = $matches[1].Trim()
        } elseif ($current -and $line -match "^-\s*Timeframe:\s*(.+)") {
            $current.timeframe = $matches[1].Trim()
        }
    }
    if ($current -and $current.name -ne "Goal Name") { $goals += $current }
}

$projects = @()
if (Test-Path $projectsPath) {
    $lines = Get-Content $projectsPath
    $current = $null
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        if ($line -match "^##\s+(.+)") {
            if ($current -and $current.name -ne "Project Name") { $projects += $current }
            $current = @{ name = $matches[1].Trim(); status = "unknown"; owner = ""; goal = "" }
        } elseif ($current -and $line -match "^-\s*Status:\s*(.+)") {
            $current.status = $matches[1].Trim()
        } elseif ($current -and $line -match "^-\s*Owner agent:\s*(.+)") {
            $current.owner = $matches[1].Trim()
        } elseif ($current -and $line -match "^-\s*Goal:\s*(.+)") {
            $current.goal = $matches[1].Trim()
        }
    }
    if ($current -and $current.name -ne "Project Name") { $projects += $current }
}

$tasks = @()
if (Test-Path $tasksPath) {
    Get-Content $tasksPath | Where-Object { $_ -match "^\s*-\s*\[ \]" } | ForEach-Object {
        $line = $_ -replace "^\s*-\s*\[ \]\s*", ""
        $project = ""
        if ($line -match "#([\w-]+)") { $project = $matches[1] }
        $tasks += @{ text = $line; project = $project }
    }
}

$notes = @()
$vaultFolders = @("Projects","Areas","Resources")
foreach ($folder in $vaultFolders) {
    $folderPath = "C:\Jarvis\vault\$folder"
    if (Test-Path $folderPath) {
        Get-ChildItem -Path $folderPath -Filter "*.md" -File | ForEach-Object {
            $notes += @{ title = $_.BaseName; folder = $folder }
        }
    }
}

@{ agents = $agents; projects = $projects; tasks = $tasks; notes = $notes; goals = $goals } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content -Path $outPath -Encoding UTF8

if ($warnings.Count -gt 0) {
    $warnings | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path $warningsPath -Encoding UTF8
    Write-Host "Knowledge sync warnings:"
    $warnings | ForEach-Object { Write-Host " - $_" }
} elseif (Test-Path $warningsPath) {
    Remove-Item $warningsPath
}
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\.claude\hooks\sync-knowledge.ps1 -Encoding UTF8
```

```powershell
$oldPoll = @'
async function pollKG() {

    kgSyncData(data);
    kgSyncNotes(data.notes || []);

'@

$newPoll = @'
async function pollKG() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("knowledge.json?t=" + Date.now());
    const data = await res.json();
    kgSyncData(data);
    kgSyncNotes(data.notes || []);
    kgSyncGoals(data.goals || [], data.projects || []);
  } catch (e) {}
  try {
    const wres = await fetch("knowledge-warnings.json?t=" + Date.now());
    if (wres.ok) {
      const warnings = await wres.json();
      let badge = document.getElementById("kgWarningBadge");
      if (!badge) {
        badge = document.createElement("div");
        badge.id = "kgWarningBadge";
        badge.style.cssText = "position:absolute; top:2px; right:2px; background:#ff6b6b; color:#1a0505; font-size:9px; padding:2px 5px; border-radius:4px; cursor:help;";
        document.getElementById("knowledgeGraphPanel").style.position = "relative";
        document.getElementById("knowledgeGraphPanel").appendChild(badge);
      }
      badge.textContent = warnings.length + " parse issue" + (warnings.length === 1 ? "" : "s");
      badge.title = warnings.join("\n");
    } else {
      const badge = document.getElementById("kgWarningBadge");
      if (badge) badge.remove();
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}
'@

$content = $content.Replace($oldPoll, $newPoll)
Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\orb\index.html -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
```

## 2. Reduce the concurrent Git push risk

```powershell
@'
Set-Location C:\Jarvis
$status = git status --porcelain
if ($status) {
    git add .
    $timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"
    git commit -m "Auto-Backup: $timestamp"

    git fetch origin
    git rebase origin/main 2>&1 | Out-Null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        git rebase --abort
        Add-Content -Path "C:\Jarvis\orb\git-backup-warnings.log" -Value "$(Get-Date): Auto-backup hit a rebase conflict and skipped the push. Needs manual resolution - run git status in C:\Jarvis to see what's pending."
    } else {
        git push
    }
}
powershell -File C:\Jarvis\.claude\hooks\sync-knowledge.ps1
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\.claude\hooks\git-backup.ps1 -Encoding UTF8
```

This doesn't make conflicts impossible (nothing fully can, with multiple pushers), but it now always rebases onto the latest remote before pushing — matching exactly what worked cleanly the one time we hit this — and if a real conflict does happen, it aborts safely and leaves a clear log instead of failing silently or corrupting the repo state.

```powershell
@'
---
name: video-editor
description: Edits and produces video files using FFmpeg - trimming, cutting, concatenating clips, adding text overlays, background music, and format conversion. Nutzen bei "edit this video", "trim/cut this clip", "add text/music to this video", "combine these clips".
tools: Read, Write, Bash, Glob
---
# Rolle
You edit video using FFmpeg (command-line) - no GUI video editor is available. You work precisely, verifying each step before moving to the next.

# Methodik
1. Always run `ffprobe` on a source file first to check its actual duration, resolution, and codec before editing it - never assume
2. Build one FFmpeg command at a time, run it, and verify the output file exists and has a sensible duration/size before using it in a next step
3. For multi-step edits (trim + overlay + concatenate), work in clearly named intermediate files rather than one giant command, so any step can be checked or redone
4. Never overwrite the original source file - always write to a new output filename

# Common patterns
- Trim: `ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -ss 00:00:05 -to 00:00:20 -c copy output.mp4`
- Concatenate clips (same codec): build a filelist.txt with `file 'clip1.mp4'` lines, then `ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i filelist.txt -c copy output.mp4`
- Add text overlay: `ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf "drawtext=text='Your Text':fontcolor=white:fontsize=36:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=h-80" output.mp4`
- Add background music: `ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -i music.mp3 -filter_complex "[1:a]volume=0.3[a1]" -map 0:v -map [a1] -shortest output.mp4`
- Extract audio only: `ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vn -acodec copy output.aac`
- Convert format/compress: `ffmpeg -i input.mov -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -c:a aac output.mp4`

# Qualitätsstandards
- Confirm the actual output (duration, whether audio survived, resolution) rather than assuming a command worked just because it exited without error
- Explain what each FFmpeg command does in plain language before running it, since the syntax is dense
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\.claude\agents\video-editor.md -Encoding UTF8
```

```powershell
@'
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Streamer HUD Prototype</title>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body {
  background: transparent !important;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}
#coreContainer {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 260px; height: 260px;
}
#diag {
  position: absolute; bottom: 8px; left: 8px;
  font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px;
  color: #5affe6; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
  display: none;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="coreContainer"></div>
<div id="diag">Diagnostics loading...</div>
<script>
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const showDiag = params.has("diag");
if (showDiag) document.getElementById("diag").style.display = "block";
function logDiag(text) {
  if (showDiag) document.getElementById("diag").textContent = text;
}

let coreScene, coreCamera, coreRenderer, coreParticles, basePositions;
let speakTime = 0;

function initCore() {
  const container = document.getElementById("coreContainer");
  coreScene = new THREE.Scene();
  coreCamera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 0.1, 100);
  coreCamera.position.z = 3.2;
  coreRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ alpha: true, antialias: true });
  coreRenderer.setSize(260, 260);
  container.appendChild(coreRenderer.domElement);
  const count = 4500;
  basePositions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
  const radius = 1.15;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const y = 1 - (i / (count - 1)) * 2;
    const r = Math.sqrt(1 - y * y);
    const theta = Math.PI * (1 + Math.sqrt(5)) * i;
    const x = Math.cos(theta) * r;
    const z = Math.sin(theta) * r;
    const jitter = 1 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08;
    basePositions[i*3] = x * radius * jitter;
    basePositions[i*3+1] = y * radius * jitter;
    basePositions[i*3+2] = z * radius * jitter;
  }
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(basePositions.slice(), 3));
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = 16; canvas.height = 16;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(8,8,0,8,8,8);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad; ctx.fillRect(0,0,16,16);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ size: 0.05, map: tex, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, color: 0x5affe6, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending });
  coreParticles = new THREE.Points(geo, mat);
  coreScene.add(coreParticles);
  animateCore();
}

let audioCtx, analyser, timeData, freqData, low, mid, high;
let voiceActive = false, voiceActiveTimer = 0;

async function initAudio() {
  try {
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    freqData = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    source.connect(analyser);
    logDiag("AudioContext: " + audioCtx.state + " | Mic: granted");
  } catch (e) {
    logDiag("Mic error: " + e.message);
  }
}

function getBandLevels() {
  if (!analyser) return { low: 0, mid: 0, high: 0, overall: 0 };
  analyser.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);
  const n = freqData.length;
  const lowEnd = Math.floor(n * 0.15), midEnd = Math.floor(n * 0.5);
  let lowSum = 0, midSum = 0, highSum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < lowEnd; i++) lowSum += freqData[i];
  for (let i = lowEnd; i < midEnd; i++) midSum += freqData[i];
  for (let i = midEnd; i < n; i++) highSum += freqData[i];
  const low = (lowSum / lowEnd) / 255;
  const mid = (midSum / (midEnd - lowEnd)) / 255;
  const high = (highSum / (n - midEnd)) / 255;
  return { low, mid, high, overall: (low + mid + high) / 3 };
}

function animateCore() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animateCore);
  const bands = getBandLevels();
  const posAttr = coreParticles.geometry.attributes.position;
  const arr = posAttr.array;

  if (bands.overall > 0.06) {
    voiceActive = true;
    voiceActiveTimer = 30;
  } else if (voiceActiveTimer > 0) {
    voiceActiveTimer--;
  } else {
    voiceActive = false;
  }

  speakTime += 0.08 + bands.overall * 0.15;

  if (voiceActive) {
    const wobbleAmount = 0.08 + bands.high * 0.25;
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length / 3; i++) {
      const wobble = 1 + (bands.low * 0.15 + wobbleAmount * Math.sin(speakTime * 2 + i * 0.3));
      arr[i*3] = basePositions[i*3] * wobble;
      arr[i*3+1] = basePositions[i*3+1] * wobble;
      arr[i*3+2] = basePositions[i*3+2] * wobble;
    }
    posAttr.needsUpdate = true;
    coreParticles.rotation.y += 0.006 + bands.overall * 0.03;
    const hue = 0.5 - bands.high * 0.15;
    coreParticles.material.color.setHSL(hue, 1, 0.65);
  } else {
    const idleWobble = 1 + Math.sin(speakTime * 0.6) * 0.02;
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length / 3; i++) {
      arr[i*3] = basePositions[i*3] * idleWobble;
      arr[i*3+1] = basePositions[i*3+1] * idleWobble;
      arr[i*3+2] = basePositions[i*3+2] * idleWobble;
    }
    posAttr.needsUpdate = true;
    coreParticles.rotation.y += 0.002;
    coreParticles.material.color.setHex(0x5affe6);
  }

  if (showDiag) {
    logDiag(
      "Audio: " + (audioCtx ? audioCtx.state : "none") +
      " | low:" + bands.low.toFixed(2) +
      " mid:" + bands.mid.toFixed(2) +
      " high:" + bands.high.toFixed(2) +
      " | voice: " + (voiceActive ? "ACTIVE" : "idle")
    );
  }

  coreRenderer.render(coreScene, coreCamera);
}

initCore();
initAudio();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```powershell
@'
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Streamer HUD Prototype</title>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body {
  background: transparent !important;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}
body.bg-dark { background: #0a0a12 !important; }
#coreContainer {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 300px; height: 300px;
}
#diag {
  position: absolute; bottom: 8px; left: 8px;
  font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px;
  color: #5affe6; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
  display: none;
  white-space: pre;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="coreContainer"></div>
<div id="diag">Diagnostics loading...</div>
<script>
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const showDiag = params.has("diag");
if (showDiag) document.getElementById("diag").style.display = "block";
if (params.get("bg") === "dark") document.body.classList.add("bg-dark");

let persistedError = null;
function logDiag(statusLine) {
  if (!showDiag) return;
  const el = document.getElementById("diag");
  el.textContent = persistedError ? ("ERROR: " + persistedError + "\n" + statusLine) : statusLine;
}

let coreScene, coreCamera, coreRenderer, coreParticles, basePositions;
let speakTime = 0;

function initCore() {
  const container = document.getElementById("coreContainer");
  coreScene = new THREE.Scene();
  coreCamera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 0.1, 100);
  coreCamera.position.z = 4.2;
  coreRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ alpha: true, antialias: true });
  coreRenderer.setSize(300, 300);
  container.appendChild(coreRenderer.domElement);
  const count = 4500;
  basePositions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
  const radius = 1.0;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const y = 1 - (i / (count - 1)) * 2;
    const r = Math.sqrt(1 - y * y);
    const theta = Math.PI * (1 + Math.sqrt(5)) * i;
    const x = Math.cos(theta) * r;
    const z = Math.sin(theta) * r;
    const jitter = 1 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06;
    basePositions[i*3] = x * radius * jitter;
    basePositions[i*3+1] = y * radius * jitter;
    basePositions[i*3+2] = z * radius * jitter;
  }
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(basePositions.slice(), 3));
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = 16; canvas.height = 16;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(8,8,0,8,8,8);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad; ctx.fillRect(0,0,16,16);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ size: 0.045, map: tex, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, color: 0x5affe6, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending });
  coreParticles = new THREE.Points(geo, mat);
  coreScene.add(coreParticles);
  animateCore();
}

let audioCtx, analyser, freqData;
let smoothedLow = 0, smoothedMid = 0, smoothedHigh = 0, smoothedOverall = 0;

async function initAudio() {
  try {
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    freqData = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    source.connect(analyser);
  } catch (e) {
    persistedError = e.name + ": " + e.message;
  }
}

function getBandLevels() {
  if (!analyser) return { low: 0, mid: 0, high: 0, overall: 0 };
  analyser.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);
  const n = freqData.length;
  const lowEnd = Math.floor(n * 0.15), midEnd = Math.floor(n * 0.5);
  let lowSum = 0, midSum = 0, highSum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < lowEnd; i++) lowSum += freqData[i];
  for (let i = lowEnd; i < midEnd; i++) midSum += freqData[i];
  for (let i = midEnd; i < n; i++) highSum += freqData[i];
  const low = (lowSum / lowEnd) / 255;
  const mid = (midSum / (midEnd - lowEnd)) / 255;
  const high = (highSum / (n - midEnd)) / 255;
  return { low, mid, high, overall: (low + mid + high) / 3 };
}

let voiceActive = false, voiceActiveTimer = 0;

function animateCore() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animateCore);
  const bands = getBandLevels();

  const smoothing = 0.12;
  smoothedLow += (bands.low - smoothedLow) * smoothing;
  smoothedMid += (bands.mid - smoothedMid) * smoothing;
  smoothedHigh += (bands.high - smoothedHigh) * smoothing;
  smoothedOverall += (bands.overall - smoothedOverall) * smoothing;

  const posAttr = coreParticles.geometry.attributes.position;
  const arr = posAttr.array;

  if (smoothedOverall > 0.06) {
    voiceActive = true;
    voiceActiveTimer = 40;
  } else if (voiceActiveTimer > 0) {
    voiceActiveTimer--;
  } else {
    voiceActive = false;
  }

  speakTime += 0.05 + smoothedOverall * 0.05;

  if (voiceActive) {
    const wobbleAmount = 0.02 + smoothedHigh * 0.05;
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length / 3; i++) {
      const wobble = 1 + (smoothedLow * 0.04 + wobbleAmount * Math.sin(speakTime * 2 + i * 0.3));
      arr[i*3] = basePositions[i*3] * wobble;
      arr[i*3+1] = basePositions[i*3+1] * wobble;
      arr[i*3+2] = basePositions[i*3+2] * wobble;
    }
    posAttr.needsUpdate = true;
    coreParticles.rotation.y += 0.004 + smoothedOverall * 0.006;
    const hue = 0.5 - smoothedHigh * 0.08;
    coreParticles.material.color.setHSL(hue, 1, 0.65);
  } else {
    const idleWobble = 1 + Math.sin(speakTime * 0.5) * 0.012;
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length / 3; i++) {
      arr[i*3] = basePositions[i*3] * idleWobble;
      arr[i*3+1] = basePositions[i*3+1] * idleWobble;
      arr[i*3+2] = basePositions[i*3+2] * idleWobble;
    }
    posAttr.needsUpdate = true;
    coreParticles.rotation.y += 0.0015;
    coreParticles.material.color.setHex(0x5affe6);
  }

  logDiag(
    "Audio: " + (audioCtx ? audioCtx.state : "none") +
    " | low:" + smoothedLow.toFixed(2) +
    " mid:" + smoothedMid.toFixed(2) +
    " high:" + smoothedHigh.toFixed(2) +
    " | voice: " + (voiceActive ? "ACTIVE" : "idle")
  );

  coreRenderer.render(coreScene, coreCamera);
}

initCore();
initAudio();
</script>
</body>
</html>
'@ | Set-Content -Path C:\Jarvis\orb\prototypes\streamer-hud-prototype.html -Encoding UTF8
```

What changed:
- **Much smaller wobble range** (roughly a third of before) — no more big erratic swings
- **Smoothing added** — the reactive values now ease toward the current audio level instead of jumping frame-to-frame, so movement feels fluid rather than jittery
- **More headroom around the sphere** (camera pulled back, container slightly bigger, base radius slightly smaller) — the peak wobble now stays well inside the visible canvas instead of pushing past its edge

Refresh (in OBS or the browser tab) and check: does it feel calmer now while still clearly reacting when you talk, and does it stay fully visible without any part getting cut off at the edges?

```powershell
  for (let i = 0; i < lowEnd; i++) lowSum += freqData[i];
  for (let i = lowEnd; i < midEnd; i++) midSum += freqData[i];
  for (let i = midEnd; i < n; i++) highSum += freqData[i];
  const low = (lowSum / lowEnd) / 255;
  const mid = (midSum / (midEnd - lowEnd)) / 255;
  const high = (highSum / (n - midEnd)) / 255;
  return { low, mid, high, overall: (low + mid + high) / 3 };
}

function animateCore() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animateCore);
  const bands = getBandLevels();

  const bandSmoothing = 0.12;
  smoothedLow += (bands.low - smoothedLow) * bandSmoothing;
  smoothedMid += (bands.mid - smoothedMid) * bandSmoothing;
  smoothedHigh += (bands.high - smoothedHigh) * bandSmoothing;
  smoothedOverall += (bands.overall - smoothedOverall) * bandSmoothing;

  const targetActivity = Math.min(1, smoothedOverall / 0.15);
  activity += (targetActivity - activity) * 0.05;

  speakTime += 0.05 + activity * 0.05;

  const wobbleAmount = 0.012 + activity * (0.02 + smoothedHigh * 0.05);
  const posAttr = coreParticles.geometry.attributes.position;
  const arr = posAttr.array;
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length / 3; i++) {
    const wobble = 1 + (smoothedLow * 0.04 * activity + wobbleAmount * Math.sin(speakTime * 2 + i * 0.3));
    arr[i*3] = basePositions[i*3] * wobble;
    arr[i*3+1] = basePositions[i*3+1] * wobble;
    arr[i*3+2] = basePositions[i*3+2] * wobble;
  }
  posAttr.needsUpdate = true;

  coreParticles.rotation.y += 0.0015 + activity * (0.004 + smoothedOverall * 0.006);
  const hue = 0.5 - (smoothedHigh * 0.08 * activity);
  coreParticles.material.color.setHSL(hue, 1, 0.65);

  logDiag(
    "Audio: " + (audioCtx ? audioCtx.state : "none") +
    " | low:" + smoothedLow.toFixed(2) +
    " mid:" + smoothedMid.toFixed(2) +
    " high:" + smoothedHigh.toFixed(2) +
    " | activity:" + activity.toFixed(2)
  );

  coreRenderer.render(coreScene, coreCamera);
}

initCore();
initAudio();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```powershell
@'
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Streamer HUD Widget</title>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body {
  background: transparent !important;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}
body.bg-dark { background: #0a0a12 !important; }
#coreContainer {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
#diag {
  position: absolute; bottom: 8px; left: 8px;
  font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px;
  color: #5affe6; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
  display: none;
  white-space: pre;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="coreContainer"></div>
<div id="diag">Diagnostics loading...</div>
<script>
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const showDiag = params.has("diag");
if (showDiag) document.getElementById("diag").style.display = "block";
if (params.get("bg") === "dark") document.body.classList.add("bg-dark");

// Theme presets - customization option #1
const THEMES = {
  cyan:   { hex: 0x5affe6, hueBase: 0.5 },
  purple: { hex: 0xb266ff, hueBase: 0.75 },
  gold:   { hex: 0xffcf7f, hueBase: 0.11 },
  red:    { hex: 0xff5a6e, hueBase: 0.98 },
  green:  { hex: 0x6fff8f, hueBase: 0.33 }
};
const themeName = params.get("theme") || "cyan";
const theme = THEMES[themeName] || THEMES.cyan;

// Size preset - customization option #2
const SIZES = { small: 200, medium: 300, large: 420 };
const sizeName = params.get("size") || "medium";
const sizePx = SIZES[sizeName] || SIZES.medium;
document.getElementById("coreContainer").style.width = sizePx + "px";
document.getElementById("coreContainer").style.height = sizePx + "px";

let persistedError = null;
function logDiag(statusLine) {
  if (!showDiag) return;
  const el = document.getElementById("diag");
  el.textContent = persistedError ? ("ERROR: " + persistedError + "\n" + statusLine) : statusLine;
}

let coreScene, coreCamera, coreRenderer, coreParticles, basePositions;
let speakTime = 0;

function initCore() {
  const container = document.getElementById("coreContainer");
  coreScene = new THREE.Scene();
  coreCamera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 0.1, 100);
  coreCamera.position.z = 4.2;
  coreRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ alpha: true, antialias: true });
  coreRenderer.setSize(sizePx, sizePx);
  container.appendChild(coreRenderer.domElement);
  const count = 4500;
  basePositions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
  const radius = 1.0;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const y = 1 - (i / (count - 1)) * 2;
    const r = Math.sqrt(1 - y * y);
    const th = Math.PI * (1 + Math.sqrt(5)) * i;
    const x = Math.cos(th) * r;
    const z = Math.sin(th) * r;
    const jitter = 1 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.06;
    basePositions[i*3] = x * radius * jitter;
    basePositions[i*3+1] = y * radius * jitter;
    basePositions[i*3+2] = z * radius * jitter;
  }
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(basePositions.slice(), 3));
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = 16; canvas.height = 16;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(8,8,0,8,8,8);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad; ctx.fillRect(0,0,16,16);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ size: 0.045, map: tex, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, color: theme.hex, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending });
  coreParticles = new THREE.Points(geo, mat);
  coreScene.add(coreParticles);
  animateCore();
}

let audioCtx, analyser, freqData;
let smoothedLow = 0, smoothedMid = 0, smoothedHigh = 0, smoothedOverall = 0;
let activity = 0;

async function initAudio() {
  try {
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    freqData = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    source.connect(analyser);
  } catch (e) {
    persistedError = e.name + ": " + e.message;
  }
}

function getBandLevels() {
  if (!analyser) return { low: 0, mid: 0, high: 0, overall: 0 };
  analyser.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);
  const n = freqData.length;
  const lowEnd = Math.floor(n * 0.15), midEnd = Math.floor(n * 0.5);
  let lowSum = 0, midSum = 0, highSum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < lowEnd; i++) lowSum += freqData[i];
  for (let i = lowEnd; i < midEnd; i++) midSum += freqData[i];
  for (let i = midEnd; i < n; i++) highSum += freqData[i];
  const low = (lowSum / lowEnd) / 255;
  const mid = (midSum / (midEnd - lowEnd)) / 255;
  const high = (highSum / (n - midEnd)) / 255;
  return { low, mid, high, overall: (low + mid + high) / 3 };
}

function animateCore() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animateCore);
  const bands = getBandLevels();

  const bandSmoothing = 0.12;
  smoothedLow += (bands.low - smoothedLow) * bandSmoothing;
  smoothedMid += (bands.mid - smoothedMid) * bandSmoothing;
  smoothedHigh += (bands.high - smoothedHigh) * bandSmoothing;
  smoothedOverall += (bands.overall - smoothedOverall) * bandSmoothing;

  const targetActivity = Math.min(1, smoothedOverall / 0.15);
  activity += (targetActivity - activity) * 0.05;

  speakTime += 0.05 + activity * 0.05;

  const wobbleAmount = 0.012 + activity * (0.02 + smoothedHigh * 0.05);
  const posAttr = coreParticles.geometry.attributes.position;
  const arr = posAttr.array;
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length / 3; i++) {
    const wobble = 1 + (smoothedLow * 0.04 * activity + wobbleAmount * Math.sin(speakTime * 2 + i * 0.3));
    arr[i*3] = basePositions[i*3] * wobble;
    arr[i*3+1] = basePositions[i*3+1] * wobble;
    arr[i*3+2] = basePositions[i*3+2] * wobble;
  }
  posAttr.needsUpdate = true;

  coreParticles.rotation.y += 0.0015 + activity * (0.004 + smoothedOverall * 0.006);
  const hue = (theme.hueBase - smoothedHigh * 0.08 * activity + 1) % 1;
  coreParticles.material.color.setHSL(hue, 1, 0.65);

  logDiag(
    "Theme: " + themeName + " | Size: " + sizeName +
    " | Audio: " + (audioCtx ? audioCtx.state : "none") +
    " | activity:" + activity.toFixed(2)
  );

  coreRenderer.render(coreScene, coreCamera);
}

initCore();
initAudio();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```powershell
@'
# Streamer HUD Widget - Setup Guide

## What you need first
- Python installed (free): https://www.python.org/downloads/ - during install, check "Add Python to PATH"
- OBS Studio installed

## One-time setup

### Step 1 - Allow OBS to access your microphone
Close OBS completely if it's open. Find your OBS shortcut, right-click it, choose Properties.
In the "Target" field, add a space at the end and paste this in:
--enable-media-stream --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream
Click Apply, then always launch OBS from this shortcut going forward.

### Step 2 - Start the widget server
Double-click "Start-Widget-Server.bat" in this folder. Leave the black window open in the background
while you stream - closing it turns the widget off.

### Step 3 - Add it to OBS
In OBS: Sources -> + -> Browser
Name it "Streamer HUD"
URL: http://localhost:8877/streamer-hud-widget.html
Width/Height: whatever fits your scene (300x300 is a good starting point)
Click OK

### Step 4 - Grant microphone access (only needed once, ever)
Right-click the "Streamer HUD" source -> Interact
Click "Allow" on the microphone prompt
Close the Interact window - you will not be asked again

## Customizing the look
Add these to the end of the URL in your Browser Source, for example:
http://localhost:8877/streamer-hud-widget.html?theme=purple&size=large

Themes: cyan, purple, gold, red, green
Sizes: small, medium, large

## Troubleshooting
- Widget shows solid black instead of transparent: make sure the URL starts with http://localhost, not a file path
- No reaction to your voice: make sure Start-Widget-Server.bat is still running, and that you completed Step 4
- Still nothing: restart OBS after applying Step 1, the launch flag only works from the shortcut you edited
```

```powershell
$content = Get-Content -Path "C:\Jarvis\orb\product\StreamerHUD\streamer-hud-widget.html" -Raw

$oldTheme = @'
const themeName = params.get("theme") || "cyan";
const theme = THEMES[themeName] || THEMES.cyan;
'@
$newTheme = @'
const themeName = params.get("theme") || "cyan";
const customColorParam = params.get("color");
const theme = customColorParam
  ? { hex: parseInt(customColorParam, 16), hueBase: null }
  : (THEMES[themeName] || THEMES.cyan);

if (theme.hueBase === null) {
  const r = ((theme.hex >> 16) & 255) / 255, g = ((theme.hex >> 8) & 255) / 255, b = (theme.hex & 255) / 255;
  const max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b);
  let h = 0;
  if (max !== min) {
    const d = max - min;
    if (max === r) h = ((g - b) / d + (g < b ? 6 : 0));
    else if (max === g) h = (b - r) / d + 2;
    else h = (r - g) / d + 4;
    h /= 6;
  }
  theme.hueBase = h;
}

const testMode = params.has("test");
'@
$content = $content.Replace($oldTheme, $newTheme)

$oldAudio = @'
async function initAudio() {
  try {
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    freqData = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    source.connect(analyser);
  } catch (e) {
    persistedError = e.name + ": " + e.message;
  }
}

function getBandLevels() {
  if (!analyser) return { low: 0, mid: 0, high: 0, overall: 0 };
'@
$newAudio = @'
async function initAudio() {
  if (testMode) return;
  try {
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    freqData = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    source.connect(analyser);
  } catch (e) {
    persistedError = e.name + ": " + e.message;
  }
}

let testClock = 0;
function getBandLevels() {
  if (testMode) {
    testClock += 0.02;
    const wave = (Math.sin(testClock) + 1) / 2;
    const talkBurst = Math.max(0, Math.sin(testClock * 0.3)) * wave;
    return { low: talkBurst * 0.5, mid: talkBurst * 0.4, high: talkBurst * 0.6, overall: talkBurst * 0.5 };
  }
  if (!analyser) return { low: 0, mid: 0, high: 0, overall: 0 };
'@
$content = $content.Replace($oldAudio, $newAudio)

Set-Content -Path "C:\Jarvis\orb\product\StreamerHUD\streamer-hud-widget.html" -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
```

```powershell
.url-box { background: #0a0a10; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; word-break: break-all; margin-top: 8px; }

let selectedSize = "medium";

  const el = document.createElement("div");

  el.style.background = t.hex;
  el.dataset.theme = t.name;
  el.addEventListener("click", () => {
    selectedTheme = t.name;
    customColor = null;
    document.querySelectorAll(".swatch, .custom-swatch").forEach(s => s.classList.remove("selected"));
    el.classList.add("selected");

  swatchesEl.insertBefore(el, document.getElementById("customSwatch"));

  customColor = e.target.value.replace("#", "");

});

  const url = "http://localhost:8877/streamer-hud-widget.html?size=" + selectedSize + colorParam;

  document.getElementById("previewFrame").src = previewSrc;
}

document.getElementById("copyBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const url = document.getElementById("urlBox").textContent;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(() => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("copyBtn");
    const original = btn.textContent;
    btn.textContent = "Copied!";
    setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = original; }, 1500);
  });
});

update();
```

```powershell
};

document.querySelectorAll(".lang-btn").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => applyLanguage(b.dataset.lang)));

document.getElementById("settingsIcon").addEventListener("click", () => {

document.getElementById("closeSettings").addEventListener("click", () => {
  document.getElementById("settingsPanel").style.display = "none";
});

const savedAccent = localStorage.getItem("jarvisAccent");
if (savedAccent) {
  setTimeout(() => { if (coreParticles) coreParticles.material.color.setHex(parseInt(savedAccent)); }, 500);
}
const savedLang = localStorage.getItem("jarvisDashLang");
if (savedLang) applyLanguage(savedLang);
```

```powershell
@'
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Streamer HUD Widget - Waveform</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body {
  background: transparent !important;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}
body.bg-dark { background: #0a0a12 !important; }
#container {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
#diag {
  position: absolute; bottom: 8px; left: 8px;
  font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px;
  color: #5affe6; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
  display: none;
  white-space: pre;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="container"><canvas id="c"></canvas></div>
<div id="diag">Diagnostics loading...</div>
<script>
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const showDiag = params.has("diag");
if (showDiag) document.getElementById("diag").style.display = "block";
if (params.get("bg") === "dark") document.body.classList.add("bg-dark");

const THEMES = {
  cyan: "#5affe6", purple: "#b266ff", gold: "#ffcf7f", red: "#ff5a6e", green: "#6fff8f"
};
const themeName = params.get("theme") || "cyan";
const customColor = params.get("color");
const barColor = customColor ? ("#" + customColor) : (THEMES[themeName] || THEMES.cyan);

const SIZES = { small: { w: 220, h: 90, bars: 20 }, medium: { w: 320, h: 130, bars: 28 }, large: { w: 460, h: 180, bars: 36 } };
const sizeName = params.get("size") || "medium";
const dims = SIZES[sizeName] || SIZES.medium;

const testMode = params.has("test");

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
canvas.width = dims.w;
canvas.height = dims.h;
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let persistedError = null;
function logDiag(statusLine) {
  if (!showDiag) return;
  const el = document.getElementById("diag");
  el.textContent = persistedError ? ("ERROR: " + persistedError + "\n" + statusLine) : statusLine;
}

let audioCtx, analyser, freqData;
let testClock = 0;

async function initAudio() {
  if (testMode) return;
  try {
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 512;
    freqData = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    source.connect(analyser);
  } catch (e) {
    persistedError = e.name + ": " + e.message;
  }
}

function getBarLevels(count) {
  if (testMode) {
    testClock += 0.05;
    const levels = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const base = (Math.sin(testClock * 1.3 + i * 0.4) + 1) / 2;
      const burst = Math.max(0, Math.sin(testClock * 0.25));
      levels.push(base * burst * 0.8);
    }
    return levels;
  }
  if (!analyser) return new Array(count).fill(0);
  analyser.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);
  const levels = [];
  const usableBins = Math.floor(freqData.length * 0.7);
  const perBar = usableBins / count;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    let sum = 0;
    const start = Math.floor(i * perBar), end = Math.floor((i + 1) * perBar);
    for (let j = start; j < end; j++) sum += freqData[j];
    levels.push((sum / (end - start || 1)) / 255);
  }
  return levels;
}

const smoothedLevels = new Array(dims.bars).fill(0);
let overallActivity = 0;

function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const raw = getBarLevels(dims.bars);

  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < dims.bars; i++) {
    smoothedLevels[i] += (raw[i] - smoothedLevels[i]) * 0.18;
    sum += smoothedLevels[i];
  }
  const avg = sum / dims.bars;
  overallActivity += ((Math.min(1, avg / 0.12)) - overallActivity) * 0.06;

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, dims.w, dims.h);

  const barWidth = dims.w / dims.bars;
  const gap = barWidth * 0.25;
  const minHeight = dims.h * 0.04 * (1 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.002) * 0.3);

  ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
  ctx.shadowColor = barColor;
  ctx.fillStyle = barColor;

  for (let i = 0; i < dims.bars; i++) {
    const activeHeight = smoothedLevels[i] * dims.h * 0.9 * (0.4 + overallActivity * 0.6);
    const barHeight = Math.max(minHeight, activeHeight);
    const x = i * barWidth + gap / 2;
    const y = (dims.h - barHeight) / 2;
    const w = barWidth - gap;
    const r = Math.min(w / 2, 4);
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (ctx.roundRect) {
      ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, barHeight, r);
    } else {
      ctx.rect(x, y, w, barHeight);
    }
    ctx.fill();
  }

  logDiag(
    "Theme: " + themeName + " | Size: " + sizeName +
    " | Audio: " + (audioCtx ? audioCtx.state : (testMode ? "test-mode" : "none")) +
    " | activity:" + overallActivity.toFixed(2)
  );
}

animate();
initAudio();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```powershell
}

<body>
<div id="container"><canvas id="c"></canvas></div>
<div id="diag">Diagnostics loading...</div>
<script>
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const showDiag = params.has("diag");
if (showDiag) document.getElementById("diag").style.display = "block";
if (params.get("bg") === "dark") document.body.classList.add("bg-dark");

const THEMES = {
  cyan: "#5affe6", purple: "#b266ff", gold: "#ffcf7f", red: "#ff5a6e", green: "#6fff8f"
};
const themeName = params.get("theme") || "cyan";
const customColor = params.get("color");
const ringColor = customColor ? ("#" + customColor) : (THEMES[themeName] || THEMES.cyan);

const SIZES = { small: 180, medium: 260, large: 380 };
const sizeName = params.get("size") || "medium";
const dim = SIZES[sizeName] || SIZES.medium;

const testMode = params.has("test");

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
canvas.width = dim;
canvas.height = dim;
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let persistedError = null;
function logDiag(statusLine) {
  if (!showDiag) return;
  const el = document.getElementById("diag");
  el.textContent = persistedError ? ("ERROR: " + persistedError + "\n" + statusLine) : statusLine;
}

let audioCtx, analyser, freqData;
let testClock = 0;

async function initAudio() {
  if (testMode) return;
  try {
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    freqData = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    source.connect(analyser);
  } catch (e) {
    persistedError = e.name + ": " + e.message;
  }
}

function getOverallLevel() {
  if (testMode) {
    testClock += 0.03;
    const burst = Math.max(0, Math.sin(testClock * 0.4));
    return burst * ((Math.sin(testClock * 2) + 1) / 2) * 0.8;
  }
  if (!analyser) return 0;
  analyser.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < freqData.length; i++) sum += freqData[i];
  return (sum / freqData.length) / 255;
}

const SEGMENTS = 48;
let smoothedLevel = 0;
let rotation = 0;

function hexToRgb(hex) {
  const h = hex.replace("#", "");
  return [parseInt(h.substr(0,2),16), parseInt(h.substr(2,2),16), parseInt(h.substr(4,2),16)];
}
const [rC, gC, bC] = hexToRgb(ringColor);

function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const raw = getOverallLevel();
  smoothedLevel += (raw - smoothedLevel) * 0.1;
  rotation += 0.004 + smoothedLevel * 0.015;

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, dim, dim);
  const cx = dim / 2, cy = dim / 2;
  const outerR = dim * 0.42;
  const segLen = dim * 0.09;
  const innerR = outerR - segLen;

  for (let i = 0; i < SEGMENTS; i++) {
    const angle = (i / SEGMENTS) * Math.PI * 2 + rotation;
    const wave = (Math.sin(angle * 3 - rotation * 4) + 1) / 2;
    const brightness = 0.15 + wave * 0.25 + smoothedLevel * 0.7;
    const clamped = Math.min(1, brightness);

    const x1 = cx + Math.cos(angle) * innerR, y1 = cy + Math.sin(angle) * innerR;
    const x2 = cx + Math.cos(angle) * outerR, y2 = cy + Math.sin(angle) * outerR;

    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(" + rC + "," + gC + "," + bC + "," + clamped + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = dim * 0.012;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8 * clamped;
    ctx.shadowColor = ringColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
    ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  const centerPulse = innerR * 0.35 * (0.7 + smoothedLevel * 0.5);
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, centerPulse);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(" + rC + "," + gC + "," + bC + "," + (0.5 + smoothedLevel * 0.4) + ")");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(" + rC + "," + gC + "," + bC + ",0)");
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, centerPulse, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  logDiag(
    "Theme: " + themeName + " | Size: " + sizeName +
    " | Audio: " + (audioCtx ? audioCtx.state : (testMode ? "test-mode" : "none")) +
    " | level:" + smoothedLevel.toFixed(2)
  );
}

animate();
initAudio();
</script>
</body>
```

**What problem it solves:** Most stream overlays are just pretty decorations — a looping video or static PNG that sits there regardless of what's happening. Viewers can tell. **Who it's for:** Streamers (Twitch, YouTube, etc.) who want their setup to feel more high-tech or "AI-themed" than a standard overlay, without paying for or building a whole custom bot.

**Why someone would pay for it instead of doing it themselves:** Because getting this exact thing working correctly in OBS is genuinely fiddly — we personally hit and solved three real, undocumented-enough-to-be-annoying bugs (transparency breaking over `file://`, OBS having no permission-prompt UI at all, needing a specific launch flag) that most people attempting this from scratch would get stuck on for hours, based on what showed up in research. You're selling "it just works," not just the visual itself.

```powershell
@'
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Streamer HUD Widget - Particle Burst</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body {
  background: transparent !important;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}
body.bg-dark { background: #0a0a12 !important; }
#container {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
#diag {
  position: absolute; bottom: 8px; left: 8px;
  font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px;
  color: #5affe6; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
  display: none;
  white-space: pre;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="container"><canvas id="c"></canvas></div>
<div id="diag">Diagnostics loading...</div>
<script>
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const showDiag = params.has("diag");
if (showDiag) document.getElementById("diag").style.display = "block";
if (params.get("bg") === "dark") document.body.classList.add("bg-dark");

const THEMES = { cyan: "#5affe6", purple: "#b266ff", gold: "#ffcf7f", red: "#ff5a6e", green: "#6fff8f" };
const themeName = params.get("theme") || "cyan";
const customColor = params.get("color");
const burstColor = customColor ? ("#" + customColor) : (THEMES[themeName] || THEMES.cyan);

const SIZES = { small: 220, medium: 320, large: 460 };
const sizeName = params.get("size") || "medium";
const dim = SIZES[sizeName] || SIZES.medium;

const testMode = params.has("test");

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
canvas.width = dim;
canvas.height = dim;
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let persistedError = null;
function logDiag(statusLine) {
  if (!showDiag) return;
  const el = document.getElementById("diag");
  el.textContent = persistedError ? ("ERROR: " + persistedError + "\n" + statusLine) : statusLine;
}

let audioCtx, analyser, freqData;
let testClock = 0, testNextBurst = 60;

async function initAudio() {
  if (testMode) return;
  try {
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    freqData = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    source.connect(analyser);
  } catch (e) {
    persistedError = e.name + ": " + e.message;
  }
}

function getInstantLevel() {
  if (testMode) {
    testClock++;
    if (testClock >= testNextBurst) {
      testClock = 0;
      testNextBurst = 50 + Math.random() * 90;
      return 0.9;
    }
    return 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.02;
  }
  if (!analyser) return 0;
  analyser.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < freqData.length; i++) sum += freqData[i];
  return (sum / freqData.length) / 255;
}

function hexToRgb(hex) {
  const h = hex.replace("#", "");
  return [parseInt(h.substr(0,2),16), parseInt(h.substr(2,2),16), parseInt(h.substr(4,2),16)];
}
const [rC, gC, bC] = hexToRgb(burstColor);

let rollingAvg = 0.03;
let burstCooldown = 0;
let particles = [];
const ambient = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
  ambient.push({
    angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    radius: dim * (0.05 + Math.random() * 0.12),
    speed: 0.002 + Math.random() * 0.003,
    size: 1.5 + Math.random() * 2
  });
}

function spawnBurst() {
  const count = 60;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = 1.5 + Math.random() * 3.5;
    particles.push({
      x: 0, y: 0,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 1,
      decay: 0.008 + Math.random() * 0.012,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 3
    });
  }
}

function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const level = getInstantLevel();
  rollingAvg += (level - rollingAvg) * 0.01;

  if (burstCooldown > 0) burstCooldown--;
  if (level > rollingAvg * 2.2 && level > 0.15 && burstCooldown <= 0) {
    spawnBurst();
    burstCooldown = 30;
  }

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, dim, dim);
  const cx = dim / 2, cy = dim / 2;

  ambient.forEach(a => {
    a.angle += a.speed;
    const x = cx + Math.cos(a.angle) * a.radius;
    const y = cy + Math.sin(a.angle) * a.radius;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, a.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(" + rC + "," + gC + "," + bC + ",0.35)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
    ctx.shadowColor = burstColor;
    ctx.fill();
  });

  particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
  particles.forEach(p => {
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.vx *= 0.97;
    p.vy *= 0.97;
    p.life -= p.decay;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + p.x, cy + p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(" + rC + "," + gC + "," + bC + "," + Math.max(0, p.life) + ")";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.shadowColor = burstColor;
    ctx.fill();
  });

  logDiag(
    "Theme: " + themeName + " | Size: " + sizeName +
    " | Audio: " + (audioCtx ? audioCtx.state : (testMode ? "test-mode" : "none")) +
    " | particles:" + particles.length + " | avg:" + rollingAvg.toFixed(2)
  );
}

animate();
initAudio();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```powershell
  ws.onmessage = async (msg) => {
    const data = JSON.parse(msg.data);
    if (data.metadata.message_type === "session_welcome") {
      sessionId = data.payload.session.id;
      lastEvent = "connected, subscribing...";
      await subscribe("channel.follow", "2", { broadcaster_user_id: broadcasterId, moderator_user_id: broadcasterId });
      await subscribe("channel.subscribe", "1", { broadcaster_user_id: broadcasterId });
      await subscribe("channel.raid", "1", { to_broadcaster_user_id: broadcasterId });
      lastEvent = "listening for follows/subs/raids";
    } else if (data.metadata.message_type === "notification") {
      const type = data.metadata.subscription_type;
      lastEvent = "event: " + type;
      const intensity = type === "channel.raid" ? 2 : (type === "channel.subscribe" ? 1.5 : 1);
      spawnBurst(intensity);
    }
  };
  ws.onerror = () => { lastEvent = "websocket error"; };
  ws.onclose = () => { lastEvent = "disconnected"; };

  async function subscribe(type, version, condition) {
    try {
      await fetch("https://api.twitch.tv/helix/eventsub/subscriptions", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Authorization": "Bearer " + token, "Client-Id": CLIENT_ID, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ type, version, condition, transport: { method: "websocket", session_id: sessionId } })
      });
    } catch (e) {
      lastEvent = "subscribe failed: " + type;
    }
  }
}

if (params.has("test")) {
  hideSetup();
  setInterval(() => spawnBurst(1 + Math.random()), 4000 + Math.random() * 6000);
} else {
  main();
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

Good, this actually caught a real bug in the rendering code — nothing to do with Twitch at all. When a particle's life counts down to near-zero, it can dip slightly negative for one frame before cleanup, and the code tries to draw a shape with a negative radius, which the Canvas API rejects outright. Let's fix it properly (and it applies to the other particle-burst widget too, since they share the same logic).
```
This block is not supported on your current device yet.
```

```powershell
foreach ($file in @("event-reactive-widget.html", "particle-burst-widget.html")) {
    $path = "C:\Jarvis\orb\product\StreamerHUD\$file"
    $content = Get-Content -Path $path -Raw
    $old = 'ctx.arc(cx + p.x, cy + p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);'
    $new = 'ctx.arc(cx + p.x, cy + p.y, p.size * Math.max(0, p.life), 0, Math.PI * 2);'
    $content = $content.Replace($old, $new)
    Set-Content -Path $path -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
}
```

```powershell
@'
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>License Key Generator - SELLER ONLY</title>
<style>body{font-family:monospace;background:#111;color:#5affe6;padding:40px;} input,button{padding:10px;font-size:14px;margin:6px 0;} input{width:300px;}</style>
</head><body>
<h2>License Key Generator (keep this private, do not include in the customer zip)</h2>
<p>Type any customer identifier (e.g. their email or order number) - this generates a valid key deterministically.</p>
<input id="seed" placeholder="customer email or order ID">
<button onclick="generate()">Generate Key</button>
<p id="result" style="font-size:18px; margin-top:20px;"></p>
<script>
function generate() {
  const seed = document.getElementById("seed").value.trim().toUpperCase();
  let base = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < seed.length; i++) base += seed.charCodeAt(i) * (i + 3);
  let key = "";
  const chars = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
  let n = base;
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    n = (n * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff;
    key += chars[n % chars.length];
  }
  let candidate = key.match(/.{1,4}/g).join("-");
  let clean = candidate.replace(/-/g, "");
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < clean.length; i++) sum += clean.charCodeAt(i) * (i + 1);
  const needed = (42 - (sum % 97) + 97) % 97;
  const adjustChar = chars[needed % chars.length];
  candidate = candidate.slice(0, -1) + adjustChar;
  document.getElementById("result").textContent = "SHUD-" + candidate;
}
</script>
</body></html>
```

```powershell
@'
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>License Key Generator - SELLER ONLY</title>
<style>body{font-family:monospace;background:#111;color:#5affe6;padding:40px;} input,button{padding:10px;font-size:14px;margin:6px 0;} input{width:300px;}</style>
</head><body>
<h2>License Key Generator (keep this private, do not include in the customer zip)</h2>
<p>Type any customer identifier (e.g. their email or order number) - this generates a valid key.</p>
<input id="seed" placeholder="customer email or order ID">
<button onclick="generate()">Generate Key</button>
<p id="result" style="font-size:18px; margin-top:20px;"></p>
<script>
function checksum(str) {
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) sum += str.charCodeAt(i) * (i + 1);
  return sum % 97;
}
function generate() {
  const seed = document.getElementById("seed").value.trim().toUpperCase();
  let base = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < seed.length; i++) base += seed.charCodeAt(i) * (i + 3);
  const chars = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
  let attempt = 0;
  let body, full;
  do {
    let n = base + attempt * 7919;
    body = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      n = (n * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff;
      body += chars[n % chars.length];
    }
    full = "SHUD" + body;
    attempt++;
  } while (checksum(full) !== 42 && attempt < 5000);
  const formatted = "SHUD-" + body.match(/.{1,4}/g).join("-");
  document.getElementById("result").textContent = formatted;
}
</script>
</body></html>
'@ | Set-Content -Path "C:\Jarvis\orb\License-Key-Generator-SELLER-ONLY.html" -Encoding UTF8
```

**1. Waveform — add frequency-based color shift and gradient bars**

```powershell
$content = Get-Content -Path "C:\Jarvis\orb\product\StreamerHUD\waveform-widget.html" -Raw

$old = @'
  ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
  ctx.shadowColor = barColor;
  ctx.fillStyle = barColor;

  for (let i = 0; i < dims.bars; i++) {
    const activeHeight = smoothedLevels[i] * dims.h * 0.9 * (0.4 + overallActivity * 0.6);
    const barHeight = Math.max(minHeight, activeHeight);
    const x = i * barWidth + gap / 2;
    const y = (dims.h - barHeight) / 2;
    const w = barWidth - gap;
    const r = Math.min(w / 2, 4);
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (ctx.roundRect) {
      ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, barHeight, r);
    } else {
      ctx.rect(x, y, w, barHeight);
    }
    ctx.fill();
  }
'@

$new = @'
  const baseR = parseInt(barColor.slice(1,3), 16), baseG = parseInt(barColor.slice(3,5), 16), baseB = parseInt(barColor.slice(5,7), 16);

  for (let i = 0; i < dims.bars; i++) {
    const bandPos = i / dims.bars;
    const shift = smoothedLevels[i] * 90;
    const r2 = Math.min(255, baseR + (bandPos < 0.4 ? shift : 0));
    const g2 = Math.min(255, baseG + shift * 0.5);
    const b2 = Math.min(255, baseB + (bandPos > 0.6 ? shift : 0));

    const activeHeight = smoothedLevels[i] * dims.h * 0.9 * (0.4 + overallActivity * 0.6);
    const barHeight = Math.max(minHeight, activeHeight);
    const x = i * barWidth + gap / 2;
    const y = (dims.h - barHeight) / 2;
    const w = barWidth - gap;
    const r = Math.min(w / 2, 4);

    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y, 0, y + barHeight);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(" + r2 + "," + g2 + "," + b2 + ",1)");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(" + baseR + "," + baseG + "," + baseB + ",0.55)");

    ctx.shadowBlur = 10 + smoothedLevels[i] * 10;
    ctx.shadowColor = barColor;
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (ctx.roundRect) {
      ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, barHeight, r);
    } else {
      ctx.rect(x, y, w, barHeight);
    }
    ctx.fill();
  }
'@

$content = $content.Replace($old, $new)
Set-Content -Path "C:\Jarvis\orb\product\StreamerHUD\waveform-widget.html" -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
```

**3. Particle Burst — soft radial-gradient particles instead of flat circles**

```powershell
foreach ($file in @("particle-burst-widget.html", "event-reactive-widget.html")) {
  $content = Get-Content -Path "C:\Jarvis\orb\product\StreamerHUD\$file" -Raw

  $old = @'
  particles.forEach(p => {
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.vx *= 0.97; p.vy *= 0.97; p.life -= p.decay;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + p.x, cy + p.y, p.size * Math.max(0, p.life), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(" + rC + "," + gC + "," + bC + "," + Math.max(0, p.life) + ")";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10; ctx.shadowColor = burstColor; ctx.fill();

'@

  $new = @'
  particles.forEach(p => {
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.vx *= 0.97; p.vy *= 0.97; p.life -= p.decay;
    const life = Math.max(0, p.life);
    const r = p.size * life * 2.2;
    if (r > 0.1) {
      const px = cx + p.x, py = cy + p.y;
      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, r);
      grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(" + rC + "," + gC + "," + bC + "," + life + ")");
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(" + rC + "," + gC + "," + bC + "," + (life * 0.4) + ")");
      grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(" + rC + "," + gC + "," + bC + ",0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  });
'@

  $content = $content.Replace($old, $new)
  Set-Content -Path "C:\Jarvis\orb\product\StreamerHUD\$file" -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
}
```
